summary: An advertisement for Cadbury Gems shows colorful candy raining down over a grey city as people hold umbrellas and other bowl-type objects to try and catch the candy. A man drags a woman under his umbrella and away from the candy, but she catches some and offers it to him. He refuses, which causes a sudden swirling tornado of candy to lift him into the air, as product branding is shown. The ad promotes the candy as fun and joyful with bright colors against a muted city backdrop, and is shown in a playful tone.

An advertisement for YouTube Red promotes a new original series titled Scare PewDiePie, in which the goal is to scare PewDiePie through a series of real-life horror challenges. The video features short montages of different scenarios, showing PewDiePie screaming as he faces insects, is locked inside a casket, navigates explosive environments, and must act under pressure to detonate a shock machine attached to his friend. The advertisement ends with a shot of him trapped beneath a low ceiling, screaming toward the camera, followed by a February 10 release date. The target audience is YouTube viewers, particularly PewDiePie fans who enjoy horror content.

An advertisement for the board game Operation shows a group of children sitting on the floor in a living room while playing the game. The ad features children taking turns drawing cards, each of which indicate a specific body part to remove from the board and an associated reward, and use tweezers to remove the body part from the game board. It highlights the fun the children are having playing as they are laughing and smiling as they play.

A Sprite advertisement opens with a man following a woman at a beach walking towards shallow water. The woman takes off her bikini bottom in the water and throws it to the man, and the man, confused, throws his trunks back to the woman. Wearing the trunks the woman walks to a cooler on the shore then grabs a bottle of Sprite and drinks. Text appears saying 'Zero Calories' emphasizing that you should have zero expectations when you see a beautiful woman. But you can expect zero calories from Sprite.

A PSA by 'Concerned Children's Advertisers' shows a dialogue between two blue muppet monsters telling children to not take things or eat things from strangers. The blue monsters sing a song and are joined by other muppets who sing and dance with them. Afterwards a muppet lion speaks to the camera about safety. The PSA warns children about consuming unknown objects, stranger danger and overall child safety.

An advertisment for Bauer shows hockey player Stephen Stamkos perform a field goal hockey challenge by shooting hockey pucks into a football goal. He moves further away from the goal as he continues to score successfully eventually reaching 91 yards. The ad promotes that using Bauer equipment allows you to be capable of performing elite feats at a professional level.

A Bridgestone tire commercial features a car speeding through a forest approaching a squirrel in the middle of the road. Trapped in fright the squirrel screams setting off a chain reaction. Animals in the forest and the woman in the passenger seat also scream while the driver calmly drives. After seeing the squirrel the driver just smiles, then swerves to evade the squirrel. The advertisement from Bridgestone that highlights the efficiency of their tires presented in a humorous tone.

A car commercial for the Dodge Charger features an animated 'Dodge boys' saving the town from criminals trying to instill high prices. The ad features live action footage of the white top half charger which is promoted as the 'white hat special'. The ad emphasizes that Dodge is saving the day by keeping the sale going for the viewer. Imploring the viewer to act right away.

An advertisement for Whole Foods shows a montage of people working agricultural jobs where they are sourcing food for consumption. A woman narrates about the importance of knowing where your food comes from and how it is processed with cinematic shots of nature such as the sea, mountains and farms. The ad reinforces that Whole Foods is a brand that prioritizes visibility in the food cycle ending with Whole foods branding and slogan 'America's Healthiest Grocery Store.'

An advertisement for Corn Nuts features a black screen with white on-screen subtitle lyrics timed to an upbeat song. The lyrics repeatedly use a playful double meaning that references both eating the snack and a suggestive joke. The simple visuals keep attention on the audio and text while building a cheeky, comedic tone. The ad ends by revealing a bag of Corn Nuts as the branding appears, highlighting that it comes with seven flavors.

This advertisement for Cadbury Dairy Milk Chocolate features two sisters in a kitchen discussing a potential suitor named Siddharth. While the younger sister humorously critiques his tight clothing and boastful stories of international travel, the older sister notices her sibling’s underlying interest and offers her a piece of chocolate. The ad concludes with the slogan 'Shubh Aarambh' (A Good Beginning), positioning the chocolate as a sweet way to celebrate new relationships and special moments.

This public service announcement features an elderly woman on a plane who refuses to sit next to a Black man, demanding the flight attendant move her to a different seat. After consulting the captain, the attendant returns and explains that a seat has indeed been found in first class. In a surprising turn, she clarifies that the captain felt it was unacceptable for a passenger to sit next to such a 'despicable person,' and she upgrades the man to first class instead. The ad concludes with the message, 'Put racism in the right place,' advocating for human rights and equality.

An advertisement presented by the California Alliance of Farmers’ Markets and the Ecology Center features animated graphics of farmers’ markets accompanied by an informative voiceover. The narration lists food options available at local markets, such as fresh fruit, vegetables, meat, fish, cheese, and honey, while bright, colorful animations visually depict these items alongside California landmarks, scenery, animals, and people at the markets. It concludes by listing a website where viewers can find information about local farmers’ markets.

An advertisement for Nescafé shows a young woman making coffee in the morning. After she has her coffee, she loudly plays drums with pots and pans in her kitchen causing her neighbors downstairs hear her through the walls. She gets a sudden knock at the door and is faced by her neighbors who all brought their own instruments. The four of them all play music together as the ad cuts to a screen of brewed Nescafé coffee with it's packaging and name while a narrator highlights its fuller flavor.

An advertisement for Don McGill Toyota of Katy promotes a special lease deal offering a brand-new 2016 Camry LE for $99 per month. The ad opens with a screen that shows the dealership’s logo overlaid on a red-tinted image of the dealership itself, then cuts to footage of a 2016 Camry LE driving down a snowy hill as the voiceover describes the deal. The ad concludes by returning to the original logo screen while a jingle for Toyota of Katy plays and viewers are prompted to click the link in the bottom-left corner or call the phone number displayed in the bottom-right corner.

An advertisement for Sniper Assassin: Shoot to Kill shows a fast-paced videogame footage from a sniper's vantage point, aiming through a rifle scope at targets across a city. Intense action is shown through quick scene cuts from streets, vehicles, rooftops and aerial views, while upbeat music plays. A bullet is shown in slow motion as it travels towards its target, emphasizing precision and impact. The ad promotes the game as intense, action-packed sniper combat.

An advertisement for a special episode of Disney Channel’s Austin & Ally centers on Trish De La Rosa being cast as Sleeping Beauty in a school play. The ad initially highlights her excitement in landing the role, but the tone shifts when Trish and her friends discover mean comments left about her on the play’s website. Although she tries to appear unbothered at first, later scenes show her crying to a friend and continuing to face bullying both at school and online, underscoring the emotional challenges she endures.

An advertisement for Disney Cruise Line shows an animated photo slideshow of Disney parks, cruise liners, iconic characters and branding,  families smiling and laughing together, and people on the beach. Text graphics states there are four theme parks, four Disney ships, a private island, and a cruise port located near Walt Disney World. The ad promotes adventure, fantasy, and excitement for Disney attractions, using an upbeat and joyful tone aimed at families.

This Fox Sports ad shows a man at a spa trying to persuade the massage therapist to add an extra service. After a brief back-and-forth, she agrees for an additional fee and then turns on a TV so he can watch a rugby match. The twist highlights that dedicated sports fans prioritize watching live games over relaxing, reinforcing Fox Sports’ message that it is made for sports enthusiasts.

An advertisement for Toyota Scion iA shows an inflatable tube man driving a car through city streets. A voice over explains the features of the car while the tube man drives, parallel parks, uses the car's touchscreen, and tries holding a coffee cup. The ad promotes Toyota as easygoing and quirky with a humorous and informative tone.

This Coca-Cola advertisement features two young women engaging in a rhythmic hand-clapping game while chanting a catchy, fast-paced rhyme at an outdoor table. As they play, the game progressively speeds up, highlighting their coordination and shared fun, with a bottle of Coca-Cola prominently placed between them. The commercial concludes with the iconic brand logo, emphasizing the beverage as a refreshing catalyst for social connection and lighthearted moments among friends.

This Nike advertisement features Lance Armstrong leading a group of cyclists on a road ride before abruptly veering off-course into the wilderness. He navigates extreme obstacles including steep forests and rushing rivers on a standard road bike, while the other riders suffer multiple crashes. After being the only cyclist to return to the paved road, the ad concludes with the slogan 'enjoy the weather' and the Nike swoosh. This positions the brand's apparel as durable enough for the most grueling outdoor elements.

An advertisement for CHI St. Luke's Health Sugar Land Hospital announces it's new Family Birthing Center. A female announcer explains that the center will open soon over a soft instrumental music. A cupcake with a lit sparkler appears to the right of the hospital's on-screen text about the new wing. The ad ends with CHI St. Luke's Health branding and their website on screen.

An advertisement for the Hope Scholarship Preservation Act in Georgia displays a cartoon-style map of the United States that zooms in on Georgia. As the narrator discusses the need to preserve the scholarship due to funding shortages, destination casino resort buildings appear across the state map. The narrator highlights an upcoming vote and encourages and targets Georgia voters to support destination vacation resort locations that would generate an additional $250 million annually for the HOPE Scholarship.

A PSA about the dangers of driving distracted shows a montage of scenes from the life of a teenage girl - her bedroom, photos and videos of her as a child, and a letter on her laptop. Her voice over reads the letter, which is an apology to her parents, and the montage ends with the her using her phone while driving and ending up in car crash. The PSA urges teenagers against driving while using a phone and is presented in a serious and sad tone.

An advertisement for M&M's shows a beautiful woman at a party who waves and plays with her hair at an animated M&M man and an animated pretzel man. The pretzel tells the M&M that the woman wants both of them and encourages him to approach her with him, but the M&M expresses hesitation. The pretzel points out that they are a salty-sweet snack, that salty-sweet snacks get eaten, and that he would prefer her over the man looking hungrily at them. The scene then pans to this man as the song Hungry Eyes plays, adding to the comedic tone.

This is an advertisement with a lighthearted, fun tone for an online eyeglasses store, Eyeconic, about a woman who plays a teacher who needs new glasses. The ad features the teacher, in her classroom, trying to shoot a commercial  while she flubs her lines. The ad features her sitting at her sofa shopping online, doing yoga in a park and sitting her her classroom. It highlights how the process of buying glasses is so easy with Eyeconic that even a woman like her can do it.

An advertisement for Cadbury's Flake features a woman with long curly hair enjoying a Cadbury chocolate bar while surrounded by a field of sunflowers. The scene transitions to the woman traveling in a horse-drawn carriage as she continues to savor the treat against a sunset backdrop. The commercial emphasizes the product's signature crumbly and flaky texture, aiming to convey a sense of unique indulgness. It uses a serene, nostalgic tone and concludes by labeling the product as the flakiest milk chocolate in the world.

An ad by Rockstar Games showing off the DLC Further Adventures in Finance and Felony for Grand Theft Auto Online shows new vehicles, office spaces, and new heists for the player to enjoy. Rock music plays in the background as a clip montage of the new vehicles and heists is shown. The ad is presented in a upbeat and exciting tone.

An advertisement for The Cool Jazz Music Channel shows a still image of a microphone and a piano as a voice over talks about what type of jazz and which artists are played on the channel. The ad promotes an informed, relaxed, and high-class service.

This is a PSA campaign for Transport Safety. The video opens with a father dropping off his two kids from his car by the street. The video then cuts to two men driving very fast down the road from the opposite direction of the father, when then the two men's car skids after seeing a bird on the road and loses control as it swerves to dodge the incoming car. The car swerves down the street and crashes into the two kids on the side of the street. The video then cuts to the tag line 'The faster you go, The bigger the mess.' after showing the two men distraught over what they have done, emphasizing the danger of speeding.

An advertisement for UOB shows a  young boy observe their father as they grow up and then they themselves become a father with their own child.

The ad features the moral and ethical choices in regular life that the father makes throughout the boy's upbringing that ingrains into the growing boy's own value system.

It shows that what is seen by example as leadership is how someone tends to become.

The ad is presented in a heartwarming, insightful tone.

The video shows Derrick Rose and David Lee playing as themselves in NBA 2K11, exchanging playful banter as they face off. Derrick Rose’s in-game character blocks David Lee’s shot, after which Rose hands Lee a T-shirt featuring his face and the phrase “Got schooled by Derrick Rose.” Rajon Rondo joins the two on the couch wearing a shirt with both players’ faces and the text “I have a ring, I’m better than Derrick Rose and David Lee,” while jokingly asking if they want anything, such as a snack or a championship ring. The advertisement concludes with the NBA 2K11 logo and the game’s availability date of October 5, 2010 and is geared towards sports gamers.

A McDonald's commercial promotes the Filet-O-Fish sandwich, using humor. A man eats the sandwich in a a garage while a robotic fish mounted on the wall sings to upbeat music about being a fish and ending up as food. Another man walks in and is surprised by the scene. A male narrator then highlights the Filet-O-Fish and the option to purchase an Extra Value Meal for $3.99 which come with medium fries and cold soft drink. The ad ends promoting McDonald's logo and slogan 'I'm loving' it'.

An advertisement for Diet Mountain Dew shows a professional golf tournament where spectators watch a golfer line up a putt on the green. Two men suddenly launch a golf cart into the air over the players and onlookers, crashing to the ground, flipping multiple times, and rolling to a stop as they shout in excitement. A narrator then states, 'No matter who you are, everybody has a little Diet Dew in them,' while the crowd cheers and drinks Mountain Dew. The ad ends with a close up of diet mountain dew, promoting the product, and their slogan 'Do the Diet Dew' presented in a bold energetic tone.

An advertisement for Air Jordan shoes opens with a basketball rolling across the court towards Michael Jordan wearing Air Jordan sneakers. He flicks the basketball up with the tip of the shoe and dribbles toward the basket. Then, a series of slow motion shots from different angles shows him jumping up, and successfully completing the dunk while airplane takeoff noises play. In the end, a narrator calls out the tagline, 'Who said man was not meant to fly' as the product logo appears.

An advertisement for Kaiser University that promotes the quality and scope of its educational programs. The ad begins with shots of people holding signs that list the key features of the university including; 15 campuses statewide, over 70 majors, degree options from associate to doctoral levels, and a single unified institution. The ad then shows a series of shots including a woman doctor, a group of professionals, a businessman, a man in IT, and a young woman graduating. The ad highlights how a degree in Kesier prepares someone to succeed and is presented in a tone is professional and is aimed at students and working professionals.

An advertisement for Doritos shows a man holding a bag of Doritos chips, with increasingly strange events occurring each time he takes a bite. The ad features operatic music playing in the background as his bites result in a woman's dress blowing away, an ATM machine bursting open and spitting out money, and a police officer transforming into a monkey. The ad concludes with the man being struck by a bus once the bag of Doritos is emptied, but he survives. The ad is presented in a humorous tone.

An advertisement for Calbee shows a boy with a sad expression and a broken heart in a text bubble above his head, walking past a human-size dog which starts doing pantomime tricks and dancing. The boy looks unimpressed and a the dog does more and more bizarre dance moves, but stops when it sees that the boy has walked away and is talking to a girl while smiling. The dog has a shocked expression and eats a Calbee crisp before jumping into the air. The ad promotes the Calbee product as uplifting with a humorous tone.

An advertisment for Colorado shows a mountain and river in timelapse, then shows two people hiking across a natural landscape. A voice over says 'you need to put yourself out there' while two people stand infront of a waterfall. The ad ends with the two people watching the sunset from on top of a mountain, as Colorado branding appears over a shot of the city.

A humorous advertisement for Kmart shows a sales associate telling a man that the store can 'ship his pants', a wordplay on a common vulgar phrase used for comedic effect. Other customers, including a family, an elderly couple, and an old man all appear and say that they will 'ship their pants' and ship other items too. The concludes with sales associate hugging the first family. This ad promotes Kmart's convient shipping services and its image as a friendly place to shop.

An advertisement for Killingsworth Environmental Home Services shows a series of men using Killingsworth-branded lawn-care tools to take care of yard work. Upbeat music plays as a male narrator says the company takes 'all the hard work out of the equation' when it comes to lawn care. The ad introduces and promotes the home services in an upbeat tone

An advertisement for Nolan's Cheddar shows a mouse crawling out of a hole and eating from a mousetrap lined with cheese before cutting to black. A loud snap is heard and the mouse is now on its back and caught in the trap, as a song plays that says, 'this is the end.' Suddenly, the mouse starts lifting the metal off the trap like a bench press as the song, Eye of the Tiger plays. Company branding appears promoting the cheese as 'strong' while using a humorous and self-aware tone.

This advertisement introduces the EZ-Cracker, a kitchen tool designed to crack eggs cleanly without leaving shell fragments or making a mess. The ad demonstrates the device’s versatility by showing it cracking raw eggs, peeling hard-boiled eggs, and using an attachment to separate yolks from whites. The video also features the EZ-Scrambler bonus tool, which mixes eggs inside the shell, highlighting a convenient and mess-free cooking experience offered at an affordable price.

A black-and-white advertisement for William Lawson's shows men from two opposing team running onto a football field in a crowded stadium, with one team shirtless and wearing kilts and the other in rugby uniforms. The teams line up and the players wearing rugby uniforms chant and dance while the kilted men face them expressionlesss. The kilted men then lift their kilts, and the camera cuts to the other team's leader, who's eyes widen. The advertisement ends with a shot of William Lawson's Scotch on a black screen where a narrator says the tagline, 'No rules. Great Scotch' with a scottish accent. The tone is humorous.

A Project Mc2 commercial shows four girls in a stylish, high-energy intro before cutting to a classroom scene where they celebrate together. A catchy, upbeat jingle plays as a montage highlighting Project Mc2 dolls being handled by children, with the lyrics describing each doll’s science-themed features and experiment-based activities. The ad ends by showing the dolls in their packaging, followed by the girls dancing and smiling with the narrator emphasizing 'Smart is the new cool.'

This lighthearted advertisement for Pepsi features model Cindy Crawford and comedian James Corden recreating Crawford’s iconic 1992 commercial. Both arrive at a remote gas station in a red sports car and purchase a Pepsi from a vintage vending machine, while two young boys watch in awe. The ad humorously shifts the boys' focus from the celebrities to the newly designed Pepsi can, highlighting its refreshed look and 'beautiful' appeal.

An advertisement for the Breville Juice Fountain Cold shows a woman speaking directly to the camera while demonstrating the juicer. Quick cuts highlight close-up shots of fruits and vegetables being added, crushed, and processed into fresh juice. The ad repeatedly focuses on the machine’s parts and the finished drinks in cups, while brand text appears on screen. The overall tone is upbeat and informative, emphasizing fast and efficient juicing.

An advertisement (with no sound) for the Late Show with David Letterman shows talk show hosts David Letterman, Oprah, and Jay Leno sitting on a couch watching television while eating chips. The trio react to the TV and talk to each other and branding for Late Show with David Letterman appears. The ad promotes the show to fans of talk shows in a friendly and competitive tone.

A reflective advertisement for Tropicana Orange Juice shows the company installing a 'sun replacement' light in the Canadian Arctic. The ad features the light being installed and the positive reactions to seeing morning light again by the townspeople. The townspeople also get bottles of juice from the company. It highlights that Tropicana can be the light in people's lives both literally and figuratively, suggesting that the effect of the sun is the similar to that of Tropicana orange juice.

An advertisement for the video game Deponia Doomsday shows a lone man driving a futuristic snow vehicle through a dark, snowy storm toward a damaged lookout tower while ominous, dramatic music plays. He enters the tower, walks through the abandoned interior, and removes his goggles to reveal a tense expression before pressing a red button. The screen cuts to black and displays the title Deponia Doomsday, followed by text announcing the game’s release date and publisher information.

An advertisement for the Vivo Smart Phone features three Minions descending in a glass elevator, where one begins playing music on their phone, eventually prompting them all to begin singing and dancing. The ad features the three Minions arriving at an office floor filled with other Minions who join in the singing and dancing. As the music ends and the dance concludes, the Vivo brand is revealed in bright, large letters on the exterior of the building and on the smart phone screen held up to the camera by a Minion parachuting.

An Airtel advertisement opens in a kitchen where a young boy sits at a table eating while a woman stands with her back turned, working at the counter. The boy notices a ball flying past the window outside and runs out to play. Two children kick the ball around until it accidentally goes over a barbed-wire fence, where the other child catches it. One boy eventually crosses the fence so they can continue playing together. The ad emphasizes Airtel’s reliable connectivity despite obstacles, with a supportive and uplifting tone.

This political advertisement features Rick Barber, a candidate for U.S. Congress, sitting in a tavern-style setting with actors portrayed as American Founding Fathers. Barber argues against current government policies, specifically the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) and progressive income tax, comparing them to the 'tyrannical' conditions that led to the American Revolution. The ad concludes with a George Washington-like figure telling Barber to 'gather your armies,' emphasizing a call for radical change and resistance against modern federal overreach.

An advertisement for the Apple iPhone 6 follows an Indian couple on their wedding day. The ad features a montage of the bride and groom in traditional attire as they prepare separately, sharing photos back and forth through their iPhones, with the bride waiting to reveal her complete face until they meet in person at the wedding. The ad highlights the power of the iPhone to connect people in special moments, and concludes with a voiceover stating, 'We know how hard it is to wait for something special, which is why we offer iPhone 6 on easy EMI.'

This advertisement introduces the Samsung Safety Truck, a technological solution designed to reduce traffic accidents caused by dangerous overtaking on Argentina’s one-lane roads. The truck features a built-in wireless camera at the front that transmits a live feed to four large outdoor monitors on the back, allowing trailing drivers to see the road ahead clearly. The ad highlights the system's effectiveness in both daylight and night vision mode, emphasizing Samsung’s commitment to using innovation to save lives.

The advertisement promotes a handheld gaming device from Steam, showing a person playing multiple video games while seated comfortably at home. The video highlights smooth gameplay, responsive controls, and the ability to play different genres on a single portable device. Visuals focus on immersive on-screen gameplay and hands-on use of the unique controller, ending with a Steam hardware branding message that emphasizes a portable device comparable to a high-performance gaming PC.

An advertisement for Visit the Philippines shows two women in a grey apartment emptying a bag of souvenirs onto a table, when one woman says she 'forgot to buy her mom's, neighbors brother a souvenir.' The other woman says they should 'go get him one' and it is revealed that both of them are already carrying full travel bags. A montage plays of the women on a plane doing make up, travelling in a car, and ending up on a sunny beach. A man serves them both an orange beverage and one woman says that the cocktail umbrella will make a good gift, and the other woman asks, for 'who?' The women lie down on the beach and a titlecard appears saying 'Find any excuse to come back.' promoting to visit the philippines.

A Chevrolet car commercial shows the journey of a woman and her dog through many different milestones of her life in reverse chronological order. It features the woman and her dog with the SUV after arriving at a new apartment, to learning how to drive with her dog in the back seat, to ending as a little girl bringing the puppy to a sliver Chevrolet SUV.  The ad ends with a message text displays 'A best friend for life's journey'. Showing that a Chevrolet car is reliable and will be with you through a lifetime.

An advertisement for Motorola shows a montage of everyday people using early, retro-style cellphones while driving, leaving an office, working on a construction site, going to lunch, and playing golf. Close-ups of people's hands using a watch, a calculator, and a keyboard appear as a voiceover explains that cell phones will eventually become commonplace during the “cellular revolution,” ending on a Motorola title card. The commercial uses a vintage 1980s-style presentation in an informative tone.

An advertisement for the NBA shows old footage from 2005 of basketball player Kevin Durant sitting in a classroom on a table while an older man talks to him about the other players that he will play with in his future career. NBA branding appears and text says 'NBA Where amazing happens.' The ad emphasizes that the future is promising and but looks ordinary in the moment. Promoting the NBA as optimistic and aspiring.

An advertisement for a Daihatsu Wake car shows a man removing the roof of his car with a chainsaw to create more storage space before another man arrives and shows him a Daihatsu Wake that has more space and fits three oversized bags. Quick shots of the car are shown along with company branding, before cutting back to the man trying to sticky tape his car back together. The second part of the video is made in animation style with the same plot, but replacs the men with two animated cat characters. The ad emphasizes the huge trunk space of the car, and it presented in a humorous tone.

An advertisement for Hitachi air conditioners features a woman singing about caring for others as scenes of affection between loved ones play. A man lifts a boy onto his shoulders to see a cake, a boy helps a girl tie her shoe, and a girl gently wipes food from an elderly man’s face. The video then cuts to visuals of the Hitachi air conditioner as a narrator states, “Just like your loved ones, Hitachi air conditioners care for you.” Three hexagons highlight the product’s capabilities—sensing, seeing, and cleaning—which merge into a final hexagon labeled “care.” The tone of the advertisement is heartwarming.

An advertisement for Dettol shows a boy playing outside and returning home dirty where his mother looks at him and starts singing a song about being clean. The boy runs into the bathroom and his mother speaks to camera about Dettol soap while the boy bathes himself. The ad shows that Dettol cleans effectively and is safe for children, and the ad is presented in an informative and lighthearted tone.

An Saucony advertisement features a fast-paced montage of athletes running outdoors on roads, trails and rugged terrain. A male narrator reflects on the question 'What is strong?' as athletes push through challenging conditions. The commercial builds to the brand's slogan: 'Find your strong.' Emphasizing that Saucony can help the viewer find their inner strength no matter where they find it. The ad is presented in an energetic and motivational tone.

This action packed movie trailer for London Has Fallen depicts a high-stakes terrorist attack on London, featuring the destruction of landmarks and the crash of the U.S. President’s helicopter. The story follows a dedicated secret service agent who must protect the President amidst a global threat. The advertisement highlights the film's intense action sequences and suspenseful plot, announcing a theatrical release date of March 4. The tone is dramatic, exciting, and upbeat, specifically targeting adult audiences as the film is rated R.

A cinema ad to promote the Indian animated comedy adventure TV series, starring the character of Chhota Bheem. In the spot, Chhota addresses the audience and announces the release date of his new special from the series called, 'Himalayan Adventure', and it shows many shots of Chhota and his friends dancing and singing in the snowy mountains.

The ad ends with Chhota reminding viewers when and where they can watch it soon.

An advertisement for Visit Seattle shows a bald woman walking on a beach at sunset, as a quick montage of images appear that show water on the beach, the woman playing violin, and people drinking around a campfire. Violin music builds throughout until company branding appears. The ad promotes Seattle as a unique travel destination with beautiful scenery, comraderie with others, and an emotive experience for travellers, and is shown in an uplifting tone.

An advertisement for NeverWet Superhydrophobic Fabric System, showing a representative talking about the science behind the product. The educational ad features examples of the product being used, explaining what hydrophobic vs. superhydrophobic is and what the differences are. It highlights the superhydrophobic qualities of the liquid product, using it on different item and showing the liquid propel off, not even touching the surface of the item it is applied to.

An advertisement for Molokai, a Hawaii based company for tour and leisure, features scenes in Hawaii of people enjoying leisure activities like sailing, golfing, horseback riding, sightseeing, and food tours. Throughout the ad, Hawaii's natural mountainous, green landscape is shown highlighting the beauty and diversity of land and activities that one can experience in with Molokai. The ad is presented in a relaxed tone.

This is an advertisement for the mobile game Game of War. The video opens in a medieval battlefield and a dragon is flying overhead shooting fires at the army. Two soldiers lie desperately on the ground and they start calling for help on their smart phone as 'Hero' by Mariah Carey plays in the background. Different armies show up to help them and then it cuts to Mariah Carey shooting down the dragon. Mariah Carey says to them 'Time to be heroes guys' before charging into battle. A narrator urges the viewer to download the game, emphasizing that the time to be a hero is now.

This Shopkins advertisement showcases the 'Scoops Ice Cream Truck' playset, featuring colorful, anthropomorphic characters served in a bustling outdoor park setting. The commercial highlights interactive elements like the truck's fold-down sign, umbrella stand, and a storage compartment for a variety of frozen yogurt and ice cream-themed figures. Emphasizing the brand's catchphrase, 'Once you shop... you can't stop!', the ad presents a vibrant world where numerous collectible characters gather to enjoy treats, targeting young children who enjoy imaginative play.

An advertisement for a Keep America Beautiful campaign shows a Native American man rowing a canoe down a polluted river. The man passes industrial buildings emitting smoke, arrives at a shore filled with litter, and witnesses a person tossing trash out of their vehicle. Ominous music plays throughout the ad and the video ends with the Native American looking directly into the camera as a tear rolls down his face. The ad ends by asking the viewer to write for pollution booklet box 1771, and the ad is presented in a serious and somber tone.

A promotional advertisement for National Retail Federation shows a montage of shopfronts and small businesses in Connecticut, including a coffee shop, bike store, fashion store, and furniture store. The montage is intercut with business owners speaking to camera about their small business in Connecticut while footage shows customers shopping in each store. The video ends with each interviewee stating their name, with the last interviewee saying, 'this is retail', as text appears.

This advertisement is a retrospective montage celebrating the evolution of the Super Mario video game franchise, transitioning from its 8-bit arcade origins to the 3D environments of Super Mario Galaxy. The video showcases iconic gameplay moments, including Mario's encounters with Donkey Kong, Bowser, and Princess Peach across various console generations. By highlighting the consistent charm and innovative leaps of the series, the ad positions the franchise as a timeless pillar of gaming history, aimed at evoking nostalgia while promoting the expansive scale of the modern title.

An advertisement for Grand Theft Auto Online: Cunning Stunts shows a videogame footage montage of colorful stunt-based cars driving around racing track environments. Energetic electronic music plays as cars do flips and stunts, through tubular metal structures, spinning fan blades, and suspended race tracks, ending with text and graphic branding for the game. The ad promotes the game as action-packed for gamers, and is presented in an energetic and stylish tone.

This advertisement for the video game Portal 2 features Dave Johnson, the fictional CEO of Aperture Science, introducing the 'Sentry Turret' as a consumer home-defense product. The ad uses dark humor to showcase the turret's internal mechanics, high fire rate, and various customizable aesthetic patterns. It concludes by demonstrating the turret's use in a domestic setting, such as a child's nursery, before displaying pre-order information for the game on multiple platforms.

A campaign video for Bernie Sanders for President shows a montage of small American towns and people going about daily life, working on farms, talking in coffee shops, and spending time with family at home. The video then shows crowds at Bernie Sanders' rallies cheering and holding signs, intercut with footage of Bernie talking with them. Text appearssaying, “they’ve all come to look for America” as a song with the same lyrics plays, and campaign logos appear followed by Sanders’ voice saying he approves the message. The video promotes unity in a positive and friendly tone.

And advertisement for Mobile Strike shows a war room full of military personnel watching a CGI army battle play out on a table. Arnold Schwarzenegger walks into the room and everyone salutes him as he goes to a locked safe and takes out a cell phone. He speaks loudly, commanding orders to the others in the room while pressing buttons on the cell phone. The CGI battle on the table changes and planes fly over and blow up tanks with the military group cheering as branding for Mobile Strike appears with Arnolds voiceover saying ' Download and play now, free from the app store.' promoting the app.

An advertisement for the movie Sesame Street: The Cookie Thief. The ad features Cookie Monster and friends being accused by the guard of stealing artwork in the cookie museum and trying to clear their names. A young man defends cookie monster and friends as they run around the museum and hunt for clues about who is stealing art at the cookie museum. This ad uses a lighthearted and playful tone to highlight the clean fun and entertainment this series offers, targeting at children.

An advertisement for the Lily drone camera shows people using it to record their activities in nature with an fast upbeat tone. The ad includes a snowboarder, a kayaker, and some hikers demonstrating the capabilities of the product. It highlights the camera's convenience and its features, including automatic following, easy deployment and landing, full HD slow motion video, 20 minute flight time, and more. The ad ends with a close up shot of the drone promoting the product and Lily branding at the end with their website 'www.lily.camera.'

An advertisement for Bio shows a montage of people going through important life events such a having children, getting married, and being with family members. A voice over talks about the value of time and spending time with family members as the montage transitions to shots of scientists and doctors at work, and families embracing. The ad promotes Bio as a pharamceutical company that saves lives and can keep people living longer, and is presented in an uplifting and sentimental tone.

A commercial for Nike shows a team of football players in a van staging a heist to steal a football. They break into a museum and a montage plays of the footballers dodging lasers, using football trick shots, fighting Japanese kendo robots, and jumping away from an explosion. The ad promotes high performance sportswear and cleats by using intense cinematic action.

An advertisement features Ryan Reynolds attempting to assemble an IKEA baby crib in an apartment. He looks desperate and has difficulty reading the manual and finding tools and parts. Ryan calles IKEA supprt to request assistance, but the call provides no help. In the end, he loses patience and tapes the crib together insted of assembling it the right way.

An advertisement for Dota 2 shows video game footage of a man sitting beside a fire, speaking to the camera about the different heroes and character types players can choose from. Cinematic fantasy music plays as the video cuts to dramatic scenes of mythical heroes battling enemies and monsters in a medieval, castle-like world. The montage emphasizes action, fantasy combat, and strategy before Dota 2 branding appears promoting a tournament. The ad presents the game as intense and action-packed, aimed at gamers.

An advertisment for Bangkok Airlines shows passengers and airline staff in an airport singing to the song 'Nothing's Gonna Change My Love for You.' A montage is shown of airport activities - staff holding gates for late customers, people rushing through the terminal, flight staff helping store luggage, and staff assisting families - with each person singing a line of the song. The ad promotes how attentive service and small gestures help the customers feel cared for during their journey, and is presented in a humorous and positive tone.

An advertisement for the LINE camera app demonstrates how the app can be used to enhance photos. The ad features a cartoon bunny that poses for a selfie in a black-and-white world, frowning at the screen, but as soon as the bunny takes the photo, the scene shifts to bright, vibrant colors and the bunny smiles widely. The ad then shows the bunny further editing the image using on-screen controls, like 'Brighten,' 'Smoothen,' and 'Slimming,' before ending with a quick glimpse of another character undergoing a similar transformation with the app. The ad is presented in an uplifting tone.

This political advertisement re-imagines Apple's famous '1984' commercial to critique Hillary Clinton’s 2008 presidential campaign. It depicts a dystopian, industrial setting where a brainwashed audience watches a large screen featuring a speech by Clinton. A young female athlete runs through the crowd and throws a sledgehammer into the screen, shattering the image and signaling a call for change. The ad concludes by promoting Barack Obama’s campaign website, emphasizing his candidacy as the alternative to the status quo.

An advertisment for The Guardian shows black and white footage of a man running down a street. The footage plays again from a different angle showing the man running towards a man in a coat. The footage plays again from a third angle which shows the man pushing the man in a coat away from falling bricks. Voice over explains that 'but it's only when you get the whole picture, you can fully understand what's going on', as The Guardian branding appears.

A TAC public service announcement warns drivers about the dangers of distracted driving. The ad features several scenarios, including a driver with a passenger nearly causing a head-on collision, a driver changing a CD and almost running a motorcycle off the road, and a driver texting and crashing intro another vehicle. It highlights how quickly distracted behavior can lead to serious and deadly car accidents. The ad is presented in a serious and cautionary tone.

An advertisement for Rosetta Stone shows a man and woman speaking to camera about using a language learning program - the man speaks in English and the woman speaks fluently in French. The woman says she will never speak English again causing them to argue, before she walks away and returns wearing a cliche French outfit and standing next to a bicycle with baguettes in the basket. The ad highlights the program's teaching capabilities to become fluent in any langue, with a comedic and lighthearted tone.

An advertisement for the BBC broadcast of the 2014 Winter Olympics presents athletes preparing to compete in a dramatic mountain setting. The ad opens with aerial views of snowy peaks, wind-swept cliffs and cascading avalanches as a narrator speaks in an ominous tone about the challenges of competition. Athletes including ski jumpers, snowboarder, hockey players, and skaters emerge from a steep path, suit up and then transition into a past-paced montage of competition footage. The add highlights the intensity and scale of the Olympic Games and is presented in a dramatic and inspiration tone.

An advertisement for the video game Star Trek features William Shatner playing a video game with his alien nemesis. They have disagreement after William's character dies in game to a lizard. They proceed to fight in a hammy acting style, and they both get worn out from fighting in their old age. The ad then shows more epic moments from the game then highlights the pre-order date, and the details of where to gate the game.

An advertisement for Berocca shows two lumberjack men in hardhats standing on logs in a lake. One man jumps next to the other and they start dancing, while splashing water and play fighting, as country music plays. The ad ends with product packaging sitting on a log while and axe is swung onto the log.

This advertisement for Playstation VR shows a man using a VR headset to play different games. Upbeat music plays alongside a montage of footage from a variety of games and reactions of different people wearing VR headshets. This ad emphasizes the realism and excitement of the VR games and is presented in an uplifting and energetic tone that targets gamers.

An advertisement and instructional video for a prototype plane compartment shows text graphics and a CGI render of the prototype plane where the passenger's cabin is shown being ejected and parachuting to safety. Various CGI scenarios are shown of the compartment landing on water and land, and text graphics and schematics show how the mechanics work. The video shows the practical use cases of the prototype and promotes it with an instructional and informative tone.

An advertisement for Under Armour opens with Tom Brady wearing Under Armour sneakers while practicing quick footwork drills on a football field. Then it cuts to shots of many Tom Brady replicas lined up in neat formations, moving in unison while holding footballs and wearing matching athletic clothing and sneakers. The scenes are shown from multiple angles as the narration repeats 'every single day' throughout most of the ad. Towards the end, Tom and his replicas throw the ball towards the screen, and on-screen text reads, 'You are the sum of all your training. Rule Yourself' followed by Under Armour logo and slogan 'I will.'

An advertisement for the milk powder brand Anlene shows a montage of women engaging in physical activity interspersed with shots of a glass of Anlene milk. The ad features upbeat music playing as a woman stretches, shadow boxes, rides a bicycle, dances in a park with others, plays with children, and goes hiking. The ad highlights the importance of strong bones for movement and the importance of drinking Anlene for strong bones. The ad is presented in an uplifting tone.

This advertisement showcases the Mahindra NuvoSport, a compact SUV designed for adventure and versatility. The video features a young couple driving through scenic landscapes, highlighting key features like the touchscreen infotainment system, automated manual transmission, and flexible 5+2 seating. The ad concludes with the couple ticking 'cliff jumping' off their bucket list and the ad concluding with the indian price starting at 7.42 lacs, saying their slogan 'DO IT ALL' and showing their  website 'mahindranuvosport.com'.

A PSA for Obama'08 shows an image of a woman and boy, and then fades to Barrack Obama talking to camera about his mother dying of cancer and being more concerned with paying her medical bills than her health. Black and white photos of Obama with men, women, and children are shown fading in as he talks about cutting costs of medical bills. Branding appears for Obama'08 as Obama says he approves the message.

An advertisement for Polly Pocket shows two young girls playing with a rollercoaster resort themed play set. Upbeat music plays as the two girls place different dolls on the toy rollercoaster and water slide while smiling and giggling, highlighting the fun nature of the play set. There are also scenes showing life-sized, animated versions of the dolls sliding down the water slide and riding in the rollercoaster with the two girls. This ad is presented in an uplifting tone.

An advertisment for Sparsh soap shows a woman in a yellow dress holding a baby and walking past a waterfall. The woman puts the baby down and drips water on him before showing him a bar of yellow soap. She bathes the baby with the yellow soap and the woman and baby smile and laugh. Sparsh soap packaging and branding appears promoting the product.

An advertisement for Carlsberg shows two men in black suits standing beside a cross and looking sad while mourning their friend. The men take out bottles of beer and cheers them as the camera pans back to reveals they are at a wedding and the friend is getting married. The ad emphasizes that even when big changes happen in life you can still have Carlsberg to celebrate or mourn with friends.

A PSA for the Anti-Defamation League shows newspaper articles, internet pages, and television news videos of notable deceased civil rights figures, edited to look as if they are still alive, and showing what their accomplishments would be in the modern day. 'Imagine' by John Lennon plays throughout the PSA, as text graphics promoting a positive world appear over a montage of people in a city. The PSA promotes the cause with a serious and hopeful tone, showing that everyday people have the power to create a future without bigotry and prejudice.

An advertisement for Tough Mudder shows a montage of a city and people at work, intercut with shots of children and teenagers playing outside, riding bikes and doing daredevil stunts. A voiceover speaks about the nostalgia of child-like play, before cutting to footage of adults running an extreme obstacle course covered in mud and dirt, but with big smiles, as branding appears. The ad emphasizes the excitement of participating in Tough Mudder, with an inspirational and nostalgic tone.

The Shopkins advertisement introduces the imaginative world of Shopville, where tiny grocery-themed characters come to life in a colorful animated setting. The scenes switch back and forth between animation and live action, showing a little girl interacting with and collecting Shopkins characters representing frozen treats, bakery items, and fresh produce. The commercial highlights over 148 collectible characters, including exclusive limited editions, and encourages kids to expand their collections with blind bags and play sets. Upbeat music reinforces the message that the fun continues after each shopping spree.

An advertisement for Livita opens with a fast zoom in and zoom out on a soda bottle as it is twisted open. The cap pops off and flies into the air, and the liquid sprays out from being shaken before cutting to a close-up of someone holding the bottle to their lips and quickly downing the drink. The bottle is then slammed onto a concrete table as rock music plays and a voiceover promotes the drink. The video ends with product packaging and Livita branding on screen alongside a company logo.

This road safety advertisement depicts a car accident to emphasize the vital importance of wearing a seat belt. It illustrates how a driver survives the initial vehicle collision but suffers fatal internal injuries like punctured lungs and a torn artery because he was not restrained. The ad concludes with the sobering tagline, 'Always wear a seat belt,' aiming to educate viewers on the physical consequences of unrestrained travel.

An advertisement for Vizzavi promotes communication service which allows you to communicate with all your friends through email or phone all at once. The ad a Pixar style animation, features two chickens playing tennis while two chick watch. One chicken grabs a chick by mistakes and uses it as a ball. The other chick on the sideline laughs and takes out his WAP - enabled phone and messages all his friends who see it on there phone and computers all at once. 
The ad highlights how easy this technology makes it to communicate and let everyone you know what is going on. The tone is humorous and light like a cartoon.

An advertisement for ICICI Direct shows skyscrapers and city infrastructure being transported by giant aircrafts, tanks, trains, and ships to a man's house in a field. A voice over explains that the company uses the latest technology to bring the best investment opportunities to its users, and company branding and graphics are shown on a laptop. The ad promotes the effectiveness of ICICI Direct by showing that it can bring the things you want to invest in right to your doorstep, and is presented in a cinematic and inspirational tone.

This is an advertisement for the television show “Join or Die with Craig Ferguson” airing on the History Channel. In this show, the host and a variety of well-known individuals participate in dynamic conversations about controversial and entertaining historical details. Together, they explore historical events in a humorous manner, shedding light on extraordinary personalities and incidents from the past. The advertisement highlights the program's blend of entertainment and historical investigation, concluding with details regarding its broadcast schedule on Thursday evenings.

The advertisement for the video game No Man's Sky introduces an expansive virtual world created algorithmically, featuring a vast number of planets. The video showcases diverse extraterrestrial terrains, life forms, and the player's journey towards the galaxy's core. The ad emphasizes key elements like interstellar travel and exploration, aiming to evoke a sense of wonder in potential gamers. The conclusion of the message encourages viewers to secure early purchases for the game on PlayStation 4.

A Buzzfeed advertisement for depression awareness shows the repeated routine of a man, sleeping, driving, working, and etc. Everyday at work the man is greeted quickly by a coworker named Ricky, whom the featured man barely acknowledges. On a random day at work Ricky isn't there to greet the man and a woman tells him that Ricky took their own life. 

The ad features text that says depression is not always obvious and emphasizes the fact that people dealing with depression may not show any visible signs of the condition. Implying that the least people can do is acknowledge each other.

A campaign video for Donald Trump shows a fast paced montage of a fat ugly man in a suit greeting people and speaking at politcal rallies, intercut with footage of news reporters and supporters speaking to camera. Electronic music plays while a voice over from Trump speaks about his goals for America. The video is presented in a fast paced style that urges Americans citizens to vote for him, in an uplifting and patriotic tone.

An advertisement for Diet Pepsi presented in a playful and humorous tone featuring Sofia Vergara relaxing on a crowded beach while trying to get a Pepsi. The ad shows Sofia watch a young woman nearby enjoying a Pepsi and wants one, but see's the long line at the snack stand. She then tweets that David Beckham is at the pier, causing the crowd to rush away, allowing her to get a Diet Pepsi. As she drinks it, David Beckham unexpectedly approaches her and asks why everyone left leaving her surprised.

In this advertisement, western-style cinematic music plays as an office employee sits down and opens the Game of War app on his phone. Characters emerge from the screen and charge toward another employee across the room. As they approach, they notice that he has a large army from the same app and retreat. The victorious employee rises atop a Game of War kingdom that appears in the office. The target demographic of the advertisement is gamers, and the app is downloadable through the app store.

An advertisement for Barclaycard in which a man in an office takes off his cloth and takes a water slide that takes him across the city. As the man is on the water slide he passes different vendors in the city like a grocery store and a train station in which he uses the swipe feature to purchase products and services.  It highlights the simplicity and fun of using Barclaycard for payments by comparing it to water sliding all over a city.

An advertisement for Kleenex shows a woman presenting a facial tissue box to a child dressed as a red monster. Ethereal music with a breathy female vocal plays as the facial tissue floats gently into the air from the woman's hand as Kleenex branding is shown. The ad highlights the tissue’s premium quality, softness, and lightweight feel, and is presented in an mysterious and dream-like tone.

The political advertisement for Carly for California shows news footage of a female senator in a courtroom telling a military man to address her as 'Senator' instead of 'ma'am.' The video then cuts to another woman, Carly Fiorina, speaking directly to the camera about the senator, saying she will 'end the arrogance in Washington.' At the end there is a still image of the senator appears with a distraught expression as Carly Fiorina says she approved of this message.

An advertisement for Maze Runner: The Scorch Trials shows a montage of scenes from the film while dramatic music plays. The scenes feature the characters experiencing life-threatening danger, being chased through a barren landscape, and fighting villains. The ad highlights the immense stakes and action in the film and is presented in a dramatic tone.

An advertisement for Cingular mobile promotes its unlimited text messaging plan. The ad features a mother questioning her daughter about why her cellphone bill is so high. The daughter responds in textisms to explain she texts with her BFF while captions in the video translate. The mother threatens to take her phone away. It highlights that with Cingular's unlimited texting plan frequent texting does not lead to high bills.

A road safety campaign shows a sad-looking man brushing his teeth while the body of a child lies on the floor. The man is shown at work, catching the bus, walking through the park, working at the computer, and going to sleep - but every time he looks at the floor he sees the dead child. A text graphic appears saying, 'kill your speed, or live with it.' The ad promotes road safety with a serious tone.

An ad by the organization “stopbullyingnow.com”, showcases the negative impact of bullying others. It is set in a hallway in an American high school between classes, as a blonde female teen looks at herself in a mirror in her locker. Two teen females approach and compliment her on her outfit, but then they send her a text and call her a vulgar name and laugh behind her back. A special effect is used to show blood seeping through the betrayed teen’s shirt sleeve, indicating a self-inflicted wrist wound that might happen in the future. The end of the ad shows a tagline reading, “Words Have Consequences” and showcasing a fact '19,000' bullied students attempt to commit suicide each year' advocating to stop bullying.

This is an advertisement for IBM computers. The video follows a woman speaking to the camera by a computer. The words she speaks appear on screen as she speak. She narrates that IBM is the most advanced voice recognition system as the screen cuts to the IBM logo. The video demonstrates the capability of the new IBM voice recognition system and show its new innovative computers.

An advertisement for Complan nutritional drink shows school children marching and commenting on their height, highlighting one boy who is taller as he plays basketball and stands in the deeper section of a swimming pool. The scene then shows his mother giving him a mug of Complan beside the product packaging. An animated graphic presents 3X milk protein, 34 vital nutrients, and faster growth. The commercial ends with the Complan pack and the on screen line 'Jaldi Badhane Ka Plan,' as the boy stands next to his mother comparing their heights.

This advertisement introduces the Monster High: Frights, Camera, Action! doll line and movie, featuring characters like Elissabat, Clawdia Wolf, Viperine Gorgon, and Honey Swamp. The ad showcases the dolls in various movie-themed play sets, including a dressing room and a black carpet premiere, highlighting their unique styles and cinematic accessories. It emphasizes imaginative storytelling through a catchy song, encouraging fans to recreate scenes from the film with the new 'ghouls' and their specialized playsets.

A political attack ad promoting John Shimkus shows a montage of politician Kyle McCarter, intercut with images of Washington, angry faces, and falling money. A narrator criticizes McCarter while on-screen text and graphics display statistics and claims. The ad uses a serious tone to portray Kyle McCarter unfavorably while supporting Shimkus.

An advertisement for Coca-Cola shows  an animated Arctic landscape with three polar bears - one big one and two small ones. The big polar bear and one small polar bear are standing on a block of ice, while the second small polar bear is stranded on another block of ice and is looking at the water. It dips it paw in with a fearful expression until the big polar bear opens a bottle of Coca-Cola and the small polar bear swims over to the other two as they smile. The small polar bear drinks from the bottle while the polar bears hug and Coca-Cola branding appears in the top corner.

An advertisement for Audemars Piguet shows cinematic shots of yellow gold in symbolic forms, intercut with natural landscapes and close-ups of the watch’s interior mechanics and exterior design. The visuals contrast gold and black textures, organic shapes, and architectural structures in slow motion, accompanied by dramatic cinematic music. The ad promotes a new yellow-gold watch collection, emphasizing craftsmanship, precision, and mastery of time.

An advertisement for Mario Superstar Baseball shows Bowser, Mario, and Peach in a series of baseball-related scenes. The ad features Bowser attacking a ball-shooter after it shoots a baseball directly at him, Mario being interrupted while playing the organ by a baseball thrown at his head, and Peach hitting a home run that lands on a car in the parking lot outside the stadium, exploding it. It highlights the gameplay footage and advertises that it is available on the Nintendo Gamecube. The ad is presented in a humorous tone.

An advertisement for Central Beheer shows a mobster buying a horse from a man who tells him it's the best horse in Europe and the mobster says he has a lot of money on the horse.
The mobster is shown attending a horse race with a mob boss, but once the race starts the horse doesn't run and only trots in one place as the mobster looks on with a worried expression. The ad shows Central Beheer as an insurance company able to get you out of any kind of trouble, and is presented in a humorous and cinematic tone.

An advertisement for Gone Mad Chocostick shows a professor eating a chocolate snack as a student walks over to him and asks for a better grade on a test. The professor says he will help him and laughs, before suddenly slapping the student. Branding for Chocostick appears as the student uses a Chocostick to give the middle finger to the professor. The ad emphasizes the snack as wild and rebellious with a humorous tone.

An advertisement for Emily & Meritt for Pottery Barn Kids shows a door opening and revealing two babies sitting on the floor playing with toys. A soft piano version of Twinkle Twinkle Little Start plays as the baby footage is intercut with a montage of home decorations, such a lamp, pillows, a carpet, and a plush cat. The ad ends with one baby looking up at the camera as the logo for Emily & Meritt for Pottery Barn Kids fades in with a prompt to 'View the Collection'.

A Coca-Cola advertisement features a woman singing soft and uplifting music outdoors. The camera gradually reveals more people from different countries joining in the singing, each holding a glass bottle of Coca-Cola. Together they sing about being in harmony and keeping each other good company. The ad promotes the idea that Coca-Cola brings people from all over the world together.

An upbeat advertisement for Sony cameras opens with a close shot of a Sony a7RII camera, then cuts to a go-kart rider speeding around the track. The camera's on-screen interface is overlaid on the racing footage, including fast auto-focus tracking, and a wide focal plane. The ad uses high-speed action to highlight the camera's precision and capability in capturing sharp images of moving subjects. The ad ends with Sony logo promoting their channel.

An advertisement for the Volkswagen Golf showing a man night driving through a vast urban scene.  The ad features a narrator speaking a poem about a sleeping town over a montage of images, the car driving through tunnels, empty streets with shadows of a solitary person on a building, the patterns of lights in tunnels and urban views with skyscrapers. These are interspersed with shots of empty classrooms, dimly lit pool halls, a bedroom scene, dogs barking by a fence in shadow, close shots of the driver,  and two police men sitting at a late night diner drinking coffee. It highlights the idea of taking your Golf for a drive to experience the world as it is. The ad ends with text 'when was the last time you just went for a drive?'  The tone of the ad is enigmatic and mysterious.

A PSA for New Yorkers for Marriage Equality shows Barbara Bush speaking to camera against a white background telling the audience that she supports marriage equality. The footage is intercut with an image of New York with text graphics. The ad promotes marriage equality and is presented in a serious and hopeful tone.

A political campaign ad featuring Bernie Sanders talking on stage to American voters about Flint Michigan. The ad discusses the impact of environmental conditions on children's health including their cognitive development and general health. He calls on local, state or Federal government to take responsibility to protect children's health. The ad ends with Bernie Sanders saying 'I approve this message' and promotion to vote for Bernie for the 2016 elections.

An advertisement for XXL Magazine shows a rapper, Desiigner, singing the song 'Timmy Turner' and snapping his fingers against a white background as the camera zooms in. Branding for XXL Magazine's 2016 Freshman Class appears, followed by an image of 2016 XXL magazine  cover. The ad promotes the XXL magazine as stylish and modern.

Ad advertisement for McDonalds shows a family seated at a dinner when a boy walks over wearing 80s hip-hop clothing and carrying a boombox. He plays music and dances and nods his head in time to the lyrics while eating McDonalds, and the man at the table starts to nod his head too. The boy leaves as McDonalds branding appears. The ad promotes family friendly meals and sharing together in a humorous tone.

A Hindi-language advertisement for Huggies Wonder Pants presented in a warm and playful tone, shows a mother putting diapers on her infant and playing together at home. The ad features a bedroom scene where the mother pulls the diaper on the child, makes animal gestures and sounds, and plays with the baby as the infant crawls, laughs and bumps into a soft pillow. It then shows close-up demos of the diaper being stretched and water being poured on it to show absorbency, showcasing the product at the end in packaging.

A French-language advertisement promotes the mobile puzzle game Cookie Jam. The ad shows 2D gameplay where players match and clear dessert-themed pieces such as cookies, macarons, cakes, and gelatin shapes to complete levels. A narrator speaks in French while items disappear from the board and the score updates during play. The visuals feature bright, candy-colored graphics and heart-shaped level layouts, giving the ad a playful, lighthearted tone.

An advertisement for NHL miniature hockey sticks at McDonalds shows ice hockey players taking shots at a goal being defended by an extremely small hockey player as he taunts them. A voice over says to collect all the 1/12 scale minature hockey sticks while branding and product images appear. The ad promotes the collectability of the product and is presented in a humorous tone.

A vintage anti-drinking PSA from Thailand shows a man quitting alcohol and improving his life by going to work, earning money, getting educated, and contributing to his community. The ad links sobriety to personal growth, stability, and a better future. The message encourages viewers to stop drinking and focus on building a healthier, more productive life.

An advertisement for Virgin Mobile shows a teenage girl in a kitchen while her mother loudly asks for help using her phone and becomes increasingly frustrated during their interaction. The mother shifts from asking for technical help to complaining about her daughter’s behavior, education costs, and past sacrifices, creating a chaotic and humorous exchange. The screen then cuts to black with the message 'This Mother’s Day, give Mom the gift you both really want; a little space,' followed by a Sailor Jerry tattoo graphic reading 'Make Momma Proud.' It ends with a Virgin Mobile logo with website and hashtag, promoting getting off the family plan.

An advertisement for Nike shows a man being strapped into a ride called the 'Michael Vick Experience' where an employee first puts on his football shoes and helmet before starting the ride. The ride begins and the man is pulled through a tunnel where a holograhic Michael Vick gives him advice before he enters a virtual football field as a quarter back trying to score a touchdown. He scores a touchdown after passing through defenders and is congratulated by a holographic Michael Vick. The final frame shows a theme-park-style photo of the man screaming.

An advertisement for Pepsi shows two men watching a cricket match, one holding an empty Pepsi bottle, as they argue about who should go get another Pepsi. As they argue, the players and umpire on the television stop the game and call the men, telling them to get the Pepsi so the match can continue. One of the men then returns with multiple bottles and cans of Pepsi for them to drink. The game resumes once they have their drinks. The ad ends with the two men promoting a Pepsi contest where people create their own ads and winners have them shown on TV.

An ad for Troegs Beer features a blonde woman in a yellow two-piece bikini. She shows off the beer and calls it “the finest of beers,” then lets out a loud burp. The video briefly cuts to a title card showing the beer bottle and a poured glass, along with Troegs branding and messaging, before cutting back to the woman. To wrap it up, she passes gas and says, “What? It’s natural.” The ad sells the beer as high-quality and all-natural, using her unladylike, masculine humor to make it feel casual and relatable.

An advertisement for Kwality Wall's Magnum Brownie ice cream shows a woman in a palace dipping an ice cream into bowl of melted chocolate and slowly taking a bite. A voice over explains the ingredients, as close up shots of chocolate, brownies, and nuts are shown in slow motion. This ad promotes the ice cream as classy and high quality, and is presented in a sensual and cinematic tone.

An advertisement for Disneyland’s FastPass+ app uses a running joke of people saying they want to “lock it in” to guarantee a desired outcome. A woman in a convenience store asks to lock in a winning lottery ticket, followed by a boy wanting to lock in catching fish, a student wanting to lock in an A grade, and an office worker wanting to lock in a promotion. The ad then shows a family at Disneyland using the FastPass+ app as a voiceover explains that guests can lock in attraction times in advance. The ad promotes FastPass+ as an easy way to plan ahead and get more out of the theme park experience.

An advertisement for Comfyballs underwear shows the Norwegian Curling Team on an ice rink, with each member challenged to put on pants without using their hands. The ad features the four men struggling and dancing to get the pants on while upbeat rock music plays. It highlights the athletic performance and comfortability of the underwear in a humorous way.

An advertisement for Newcastle Brown Ale shows a husband and wife at home. The husband asks where the chips are, and the wife tells him to check different places around the house. As he looks, he opens a cabinet, refrigerator, basement, and garage, only to find each space packed with Newcastle Brown Ale instead of chips. The ad uses a tongue-in-cheek, humorous tone to highlight the beer as the real “snack” worth finding, and it is clearly aimed at adult audiences.

A commercial for Pond Lehocky Stern Giordano law firm shows a man talking to an interviewer off camera about a life changing work injury. He reports on not being able to make a living and suffering from medical debt, as text graphics appear explaining that his workers' compensation was denied and that the law firm helped him. The grim tone of the ad promotes the law firm as caring and that they recognize that there is a real human behind every claim of injury.

An advertisement for Smashbox shows a female make up artist demonstrating different lipstick shades on two women. The woman speaks to camera about the different color options, intercut with images of product and logos, and shots of her applying the lipstick to the two women. This ad promotes Smashbox products as having many variets for different skin colors and is shown in an informative tone.

An advertisement for Coca-Cola Classic shows a red button logo overlaid with song lyrics that pair concepts such as school and homework, a beat and a drum, and a pool and flirtation. Abstract and artistic background graphics change in time with the music and singing. A traditional glass bottle and the Coca-Cola name appear on the red button logo as the jingle states, “Whenever there’s fun, there’s always Coca-Cola.” The ad is presented in a lighthearted tone and is directed toward soda drinkers.

An advertisement for National Retail Federation shows different retail businesses in the state of Vermont. A montage shows footage of natural landscapes, bakeries, stores, and factories, while local business owners speak directly to camera about the retail industry and it's importance to the Vermont economy. Thr ad promotes supporting local business and is presented in an informtive tone.

An advertisement for the Formula 1 DHL Fastest Pit Stop Award shows the same pit stop from three different points of view: one from the front of the vehicle, one from the driver's perspective, and one from behind the vehicle. The advertisement features a group of vehicle technicians wearing a uniform with 'Ranstad' written on the back replacing the tires on an F1 vehicle. The ad highlights the speed of the pit stop, which took 01:92 seconds to complete as displayed by the timer in the top right hand corner of the video.

A parody animated advertisement for Kikkoman soy sauce features superhero themed, humanoid condiment-based characters. A montage is shown of the adventures of Kikkoman as he fights villains, gives iother characters soy sauce, rides a motorcycle, and flies  while a Kikkoman jingle plays. The ad promotes Kikkoman as reliable but with an absurdist tone.

The advertisement is a travel commercial featuring the Philippines as a getaway destination. An Asian couple sits in a drab house while it is snowing outside, with the man eating ramen. The woman asks the man to retake a photo of her in sunny weather, and he questions, “Now?” The couple then look behind them and see their luggage already packed, so they go on a flight, then a boat, and finally arrive on a sunny island beach in the Philippines to retake the photo, all while the man continues eating his ramen. The tone shifts from cold and drab to sunny and cheerful. Text on the screen says, “Find any excuse to come back,” emphasized by a stamp that appears reading, “Visit the Philippines Again 2016.”

An advertisement for Bank of Queensland shows an animated cartoon of a man sitting at the center of a desk before rotating ninety degrees as different people rotate into the center to speak to the camera. The rotating characters emphasize how banks often switch you between different staff members, while BOQ highlights the idea of speaking with one person who gets to know you. The ad ends with on-screen text reading It’s possible to love a bank, followed by Let us prove it and the BOQ website.

This is an advertisement with fast pace and lighthearted music for Balzac, a children's balloon ball featuring kids playing with the ball in various settings, appealing this toy to kids. The Ad features a cartoon character, Balzac, who appears under a spotlight and then appears as the graphic on the ball. Then cut children kicking the ball on a field, smashing it over volleyball nets, punching it in a pool and  and play with it on the beach. It highlights how the Balzac balloon ball is safe, can be used anywhere and it kids love it.

This is a promo for the TBS TV game show “Separation Anxiety.” The scene opens on the show in progress with upbeat music as the host questions a female contestant about her husband and explains the challenge, while audience members watch in the background. Quick cuts show the contestant on stage, the game setup, and her husband watching as the host continues.

A PSA for Concerned Children's Advertisers shows a girl drinking from a tap in a school hallway as three other girls call her names like 'loser' and 'geek'. The words literally fly out of their mouths and hit the girl, appearing as if she is being slapped and pushed into a locker. The three other girls laugh and the words surround the first girl as she falls over. The other girls tell her to get lost and the first girl runs out the door as text appears on screen saying, 'Words hurt. Don't be a part of it.'

An advertisement for True Effect shows animated 2D visuals that illustrate the narrator’s speech. The narrator explains how third-party cookies are used in advertising and describes their shortcomings.
