The ad shows that the cupcakes can be filled with pudding, mousse, gelatin, and ice cream, and that a cupcake set valued at $55 can be bought for $19.95. The tone of the ad is humorous.

This PSA for domestic abuse shows two kids pretending to play family. The ad features one of the kids yelling, screaming, slamming the table and also hitting the other kid. It highlights that "Kids learn a lot from their parents, including domestic abuse. End the cycle of violence". The advertisement is presented in an informative tone.

This is a political advertisement for Hillary Clinton's Campaign. The ad features her talking about what is going on in the world and how she'd like to change things while connecting to a personal story about her upbringing. It highlights one of her goals for her campaign and is presented in an informative tone.

This advertisement for Mercedes-Benz begins with a clown hitchhiking on a desert road next to a white van labeled “Party Clown.” A male driver stops to pick them up, and when the costume is taken off, it reveals a beautiful blonde woman. The man comments, “I must be dreaming,” as the screen flashes a red hazard icon and beeps. The man brakes to avoid a tractor. The woman remarks, “Not too much, I hope,” and the screen transitions to a scene of a car driving with text describing the cross-traffic hazard detection safety feature of the new E-class Mercedes-Benz “Intelligent Drive.” The ad highlights Mercedes-Benz as a high-tech, safe vehicle, delivered in a humorous tone.

This ad is for ESPN's SportsCenter. The ad highlights kids and their adult mentors playing pickup basketball, though the adults take the game too seriously and play roughly with the kids. The ad ends with the tagline "This is SportsCenter" appearing on screen.

The PSA for safe driving shows someone getting run over by a speeding car while crossing the street. The advertisement shows a doctor explaining how that accident has impacted the individual in "less than 2/10 of a second". This highlights how "10 kph less will save lives." This advertisement is presented in an informative way.

An advertisement for Qantas airlines shows scenic views of Sydney, Australia. The ad features Qantas planes flying in the air, happy passengers inside the flight, appetizing food service, and different views of the city. The ad is presented in an uplifting way.

This advertisement for the Betty Crocker brand snacks shows a group of kids on a mission to steal the snack. The ad features Buzz Lightyear on the TV, leading the mission, and the kids eventually acquire the snacks from a distracted peer. The advertisement highlights the different flavors of this snack and is presented in a humorous way.

An advertisement for Masafi bottled water shows mountains, clouds, raindrops and a river with plants. It then displays bottles of Masafi water and a person drinking it. The ad emphasizes the product’s environmental friendliness and natural roots, using an informative and appealing tone.

This advertisement for Haribo shows a group of adult soccer players sharing gummy snacks. The ad features them having conversations describing how they taste in baby voices that aren't theirs. The ad highlights the Haribo Tangfastics with their logo at the end. The ad is presented in a humorous way.

This advertisement for Unfiltered shows the effects of smoking. The ad features two coworkers chatting while one smokes, as the narrator describes what the cigarette is doing. It highlights the effects of cigarettes and is presented in an informative, if cautious, tone.

An advertisement for Martin Foot and Ankle shows a woman providing foot treatment to a patient and the patient standing on his toes to show he has recovered. After that the ad shows the woman providing treatment talking about their service and effects. The ad emphasizes the institution's ability in curing patients, using a motivational tone.

This advertisement for Samuel Adams spotlights their new Nitro Project. The ad features an infographic explaining the difference it makes when they swap carbon dioxide for nitrogen in beer, thus making it "smoother, creamier, irresistible". It highlights their different drinks, and the advertisement is presented in an informative way.

This advertisement for Star Wars Card Trader mobile app displays phones as users swipe through different character cards. The ad features action words like "collect", "trade" and "update" appearing on the screen. The ad is presented in an informative way.

This advertisement for Lanvin Chocolate shows a man taking a bite of the chocolate bar. The person then changes his expression dramatically and his mustache grows in size and stands straight up comically. The ad is presented in a humorous, exaggerated way.

An advertisement for Fruit Stripe gum shows children, a zebra, and other creatures enjoying the candy. The ad features a song with the flavors of the gum and the zebra handing out the candy for everyone to try. The ad is presented in an uplifting way.

This is a vintage trailer for a live-action Fantastic Four film from the 20th century. The trailer features quick shots of the Fantastic Four characters using their powers in action scenes. The tone of the ad is cinematic and dramatic.

An advertisement for Limca shows a man waiting outside a woman's apartment by his motorcycle. Every time he takes a sip of the drink, anything the woman touches turns to liquid. The woman comes out with her own bottle, and the same happens to him, which leads to both of them laughing. This advertisement is presented in a humorous way.

This advertisement for Anchor toothpaste features a woman baking a cake and accidentally letting go, causing the cake to slam into the wall and drop. The ad ends with a man entering the woman's home and after spotting the cake that was previously on the floor, advancing towards it and eating it. It highlights the qualities of the Anchor toothpaste. The ad is presented in a humorous way.

The advertisement for ThinkB4YouSpeak shows a group of people laughing with each other. The ad features the group using obscene language like "that's so gay" when someone else  walks in and explains why that's wrong to say.  The ad ends with that person telling them to knock it off and is presented in a informative way.

A video shows a lone girl walking  in a high school hallway, holding her books . As she drinks from the water fountain, three other girls laugh and call her "loser" and "geek".  The words materialize, flying through the air and assaulting the lone girl. She is knocked down and flees. The video emphasizes the harm of school bullying, and uses a somber tone.

An advertisement for a children's toy shows all the functions of the playset. The ad features an animated penguin character explaining what is included in the toy package and how it works. The ad is presented in an uplifting tone with cheerful music.

This advertisement features a woman in a red bikini posing for a photographer in a photo studio. The photographer takes photos of her. Then, a person behind her holds an LG Kompressor Plus vacuum against her. When the person stops holding the vacuum, the woman becomes significantly bigger. The ad humorously emphasizes the vacuum’s strength and effectiveness.

This advertisement for Battle Camp mobile game shows the video game's different monster characters. The ad features two characters evolving through three stages then battling each other in a colosseum arena. The advertisement is presented with epic orchestral music and in a cinematic way.

This advertisement is for a food brand, Knorr. It shows a Chef Einav cooking a creamy bruschetta chicken with Knorr Creamy Chicken Rice Sides, salt, olive oil, garlic, mozzarella, basil and tomatoes.  Two more dishes are shown including fiesta lime chicken & rice bowl and coconut curry chicken that recipes are available for. This ad emphasized Knorr Rice Sides and uses a informational tone.

This advertisement for Discount Tire shows  scenes of several families driving around. The ad features scenic views and shots of different freeways with music in the background. It highlight's that "It's not where you are driving, It's who you are driving with". The ad is presented in an uplifting way.

This advertisement about home safety shows a group of children playing and running at the beginning. After that, a person started speaking while holding a fruit bar, and later tripped on a child's toy left behind. The video then shows the text "make your home as safe as houses". The video emphasizes safety in people's homes, and the video uses a serious tone.

An advertisement for Prevent-It CA shows a workplace accident of a person falling of the ladder and getting injured. A coworker rushes to help and the injured person talks about how "their should be a strict policy about two people doing a job like this".This advertisement highlights that "there really are no accidents". The ad is presented in a serious way.

This advertisement is about Raja Krishnamoorthi as he campaigns for Congress, mainly focusing on the progressive candidate's interactions with people. At the start of the video, the man walks into a restaurant and shakes hands with several people including a child. He joked about his name sounding difficult, then discussed voting issues with people in the establishment's kitchen, dining room and parking lot. This video emphasizes Raja Krishnamoorthi's communication with people and his political stance, using a motivating tone.

An advertisement for Victoria's Secret shows a woman in a pink bikini lying on the beach and posing beside a palm tree. Later, the ad shows other women in orange, blue, yellow, and green bikinis posing, lying, standing, and walking around, Onscreen, the company name alternates with the words  "very sexy". The ad emphasizes the product's sexiness, using an upbeat, alluring tone.

An advertisement for Star wars and Burger King shows a storm trooper using his blaster in the kitchen of a restaurant. A manager walks in and says "What did I tell you about the blasting". The ad features the new Star Wars collectible items at Burger King that are available. The advertisement is featured in a humorous way.

This advertisement for Sony's iSweep Cyber Shot spotlights how to capture more space in a picture. The ad features Taylor Swift as she's introduced to the camera and uses it to get a panoramic picture of all her fans who literally drop to her feet. The ad is presented in a humorous way.

The advertisement for Folgers shows people drinking coffee in a city setting alongside a band singing on the streets. The ad features people in the city drinking their coffee throughout the day. A group of people stand near the band to watch them perform a song about Folgers. The ad is presented in an uplifting way.

This advertisement for [prevent-it.ca](http://prevent-it.ca) shows a male construction worker explaining that he's working overtime to take his family on a nice vacation. The ad shows him mentioning  that he is "wearing a busted harness" and that his family will soon get a call that he was killed in an accident. As he speaks about the company's failure to check the tanks in front of him, the tanks bursts into flames and kill him. This advertisement highlights that "there really are no accidents" and is presented in an informative, ironic tone.

This ad is for a political campaign from Christine O'Donnell. The ad features Christine and the message is that she is not a witch, and will go to Washington and behave as the viewer of the ad. The tone of the ad is serious.

A vintage advertisement for Folgers Coffee features a woman giving a man coffee and throwing it onto petunias, exclaiming, “Your Coffee is Criminal!” The ad begins with “Papa Eddie Solves a Crime,” a woman telling Papa Eddy her coffee is “murder.” He suggests Folgers coffee, claiming it’s mountain-grown and raising his arms into a mountain shape. A man and woman enjoy coffee, embrace, and a final image shows a Folgers coffee tin, cup, and mountains, with the slogan, “Mountain Grown for Richer Flavor.” The ad emphasizes Folgers coffee’s rich, never-bitter, and never-weak flavor.

This advertisement for Life cereal shows a group of kids hesitant to try the new cereal. It features the kids giving the cereal to a peer, who supposedly "hates everything" and ends up liking it. The ad highlights that "Life Cereal and Fisher Price toys offer a rebate of up to $150 on 40 Fisher Price toys, details on specially marked cereal packages." This ad is presented in a humorous way aimed at children.

This advertisement is narrated by a seventeen year-old girl who gradually appears out of the darkness. She stands alone in the shadows of a high school hallway, her head is bowed and eyes closed.  She narrates the circumstances of transferring to a new school, the difficulties of making friends, and the events that led her to take her own life. She  raises her head and opens her eyes, looking forward as the narration states she is the victim of high school bullying. This ad uses a somber tone.

An advertisement for Gatorade shows Oklahoma City Thunder's Kevin Durant 's shot blocked in a basketball game by Miami Heat's Dwyane Wade. After that, the ad features Durant waking up abruptly from the dream. He then trains and exercises while hydrating with Gatorade. He then makes the shot while Dwyane Wade fails to block it. After that, Wade wakes up abruptly from the dream and the tagline reads "Win from Within". This ad is presented in a motivational tone.

An advertisement showing a fast food worker announcing a new Tim Horton's croissant  sandwich. The ad shows a man pulling out baked croissants from the oven. Triumphant music plays as he is walking by the announcer and a  banner with confetti saying "Freshly Baked" falls from above. The ad is presented in an uplifting way.

An advertisement for Lokai, a bracelet brand, shows a group of people traveling to Mt. Everest to collect water from a clear river into containers. After that, the advertisement shows an image of a bracelet with several white beads and one black bead. The ad emphasizes balance represented by  how environmentally friendly the product is, and uses a cinematic tone.

An advertisement for Hardee's new milkshake shows a man and a cow in frame. The advertisement features the man shaking the cow and dancing to "Get Busy "by Sean Paul , then shows images of Hardee's milkshake. The advertisement states that the milkshake is "made with real ice cream", and is presented in a humorous way.

This advertisement for the Volkswagen Jetta shows two friends having a conversation with each other. The ad features the driver complaining to his friend about problems he is having with his partner. As they converse, they end up crashing into a car, emphasizing the importance of safety. The ad is presented in a serious tone.

An advertisement for 3 Day Blinds shows scenes of a woman then  a man measuring a window, followed by three family members standing happily together, and then the process of the product being planned and installed to cover windows. The ad emphasizes that the product can be easily installed and  is effective in decorating windows while  reducing outside light. The ad is presented in an informative tone.

An advertisement for Palla Guisado shows a person cooking. The ad features the person cutting vegetables and applying the product to vegetables and chicken. It highlights the product's ability to enhance food taste and cooking. The ad is presented in an uplifting tone.

This advertisement for KitKat shows a man in a hospital eating chocolate. The advertisement features a baby room on the side where the babies are dancing and singing as the man is eating the chocolate. The man finishes his chocolate and everything returns back to normal presenting the ad in a humorous way.

An advertisement for Burger King shows a man dressed up in a king's costume breaking into a modern office. People working there  ran around at first but expressed interest after the man offered them hamburgers. After that, two other man rush in, telling people that the "king" is insane for selling the burger at the price of 3.99 dollars. The ad emphasizes the attractiveness of the burger, and it's cheap price. Using a humorous tone.

An advertisement for a Nissan shows a blue car driving around the city in the night. This ad features blue lips that pop up during the drive saying words like "Modtro",  "Simpology" and "Spafe",  which are a combination of the car's features. The ad ends with a billboard of the blue lips and the new Nissan Micra, presented in a cinematic way.

An advertisement for the Titan watch shows an employee explaining the features of his watch. The ad starts with the employee's boss complimenting his watch, the employee then states that "it's not a watch". He then highlights all the qualities of the watch, including dial changes, music and a camera. A colleague comes in giving the same compliment, and the employee changes his expression, presenting the ad in a humorous way.

An advertisement for a smartphone promotion shows all the features included in the phone. The ad features a man unboxing his phone and his peers celebrating by jumping around with confetti everywhere. It emphasizes the promotion and is presented in an uplifting way.

An advertisement for DOE shows a group of kids in a classroom getting ready to go on a school trip crosscut with a man getting ready to leave his home in a rush. The ad features the children playing in the park, then the man losing control of his speeding car and crashing into them. It is then stated that the "safety ad was made to highlight the dangers of speeding after figures show 28 children have died from it since 2000". The advertisement is presented in a somber way and ends with an empty classroom .

An advertisement for Corona shows a man and woman sitting in wooden chairs on the beach, a bucket of beer between them. The ad features them looking to the side as someone walks by. The man shakes the bottle on the right but the women opens the unshaken bottle on the left, then hands him the bottle opener. This ad is presented without dialogue and in a subtle, humorous way.

An advertisement for New Era, the official cap brand of Major League Baseball, shows Evan Longoria's cap taken by another man. Longoria pursues him, seeing multiple people with caps from the same brand. Longoria chases the other man through restaurants and on buses, yachts and helicopters until he finally gets his cap back. The ad emphasizes the product's popularity, using a motivational tone.

An advertisement for Dior J'adore shows Charlize Theron in a luxury dress walking through a glamorous grand hall. She gradually removes layers of clothing, her high-heels and her pearl necklace, then climbs onto the roof of the building overlooking a futuristic skyline. After that, the ad shows an ornate golden bottle filled with perfume. The ad emphasizes the product's luxurious nature and innovative design, using a cinematic tone.

An advertisement for Matchbox Car Wash shows two children playing with this toy. The ad features the children smiling and maneuvering their toy car through the product, then washing and spin-drying their toy car. The ad highlights that the product is fun for children, while demonstrating the responsibility of caring for a vehicle. The ad is presented in an uplifting tone.

This advertisement for Jewelers Mutual Insurance Company shows a couple dancing near a photo booth. The ad focuses on their relationship which the man narrates. He eventually takes out the ring in the photo booth and emphasizes that "it's definitely more than a ring". This ad is presented in an inspirational way.

An advertisement for Chamberlain College of Nursing shows nurses taking care of patients as well as students in classrooms studying. The ad features multiple students learning in classes, studying on  laptops, providing care, and graduating. This ad is presented in an inspirational way.

An advertisement for Yoohoo chocolate milk shows a woman telling a man that she will break up with her boyfriend, Billy, to date him instead. The woman states the man must break the news if Billy walks in with a Pepsi, and she will do the same if he walks in with a Coke. Billy eventually walks in with Yoohoo chocolate milk, which the man and woman react to by hugging Billy and choosing not to break the news. The ad is presented in a comedic way.

This is a PSA for the Global Democracy campaign, which proposes mandatory disclaimers when bodies are manipulated for advertising purposes. It features a topless model as she's digitally enhanced for publication. The tone is thought-provoking and targets the general audience to learn more.

This is an ad for [commonsense.org](http://commonsense.org). It features a little girl angrily confronting her stuffed animals over alleged snitching, mimicking scenes from mature crime films/shows. Its tone is humorous and targets parents of young, impressionable children.

This is an ad for Starbucks's French Roast. It features a young father preparing himself a cup of French Roast before reading to his son. The ad ends with the different forms of the French Roast available, such as Keurig cups, travel packets, instant coffee, and standard coffee containers. Its tone is informative and targets coffee drinkers and Starbucks lovers alike.

This is an ad for the PS4 console. It features current and upcoming PlayStation 4 console exclusives: Street Fighter V, Uncharted 4, MLB's The Show 16, and Call of Duty: Black Ops 3. Its tone is informative and exciting and targets gamers.

This is an ad for the alcoholic drink Campari. It features actress Salma Hayek in an evening dress walking down the titular "Hotel Campari" as she crosses paths with other hotel guests before retiring to a room where Campari is being served. The tone is cinematic and alluring, and targets drinking-age adults.

This is a vintage commercial for Remco's Baby Laugh A Lot. It features a young girl turning on the Baby Laugh A Lot, which laughs incessantly to a disturbing degree. The ad's tone is informative, if a bit off-putting, and targets young girls.

This is a vintage ad for Radio Shack's transportable satellite phone. It features a man taking the satellite phone wherever he goes, including in his car, on a boat, or to the park, highlighting the phone's transportability and ease of use. The tone is informative and targets a general audience interested in making calls on the go.

This is a Danish ad for Midttrafik, a Danish bus system. It features bus passengers as they ride on this "cool bus", highlighting its modern features to a comical and exaggerated degree. Its tone is humorous and targets Danish passengers.

This is an ad for Harrah's Resort in Southern California. It features three different scenarios: help with a heavy object, a massage session, and a magic show. All three compare less-than-ideal versions with the ideal amenities offered by Harrah's Resort. The tone is informative and humorous and targets potential resort guests.

This is a pharmaceutical ad for Entivio, a medication for those suffering from ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease, and whose prior treatments didn't lead to satisfactory results. The ad explains the drug's potency, efficacy, and possible side effects. The ad is informative and targets those suffering from ulcerative colitis and Crohn's disease.

This is an ad for Nespresso. It features George Clooney as he goes to enter the Nespresso building, only to be left holding the door as women enter and leave, ignoring him. This continues when he goes for a Nespresso and a woman approaches him. He assumes she wants an autograph but instead she wants to get to the Nespresso machine. The tone is humorous and targets coffee drinkers.

This is an ad based on the fictional, absurdly designed Albanian minivan, the Tartan Prancer, featured in the 2015 comedy film Vacation. This fake ad features all of the Prancer's unique designs, like a center console water fountain, a door handle martini glass holder, etc. The tone is absurd, and it targets viewers of Vacation.

This is a PSA by the Winnipeg Police Department for their Just Slow Down Campaign. It urges drivers to slow down when driving to reduce risk for first responders -- and each other. The tone is straight to the point and targets Winnipeg drivers.

This is a computer-animated commercial for Haynes Baked Beans. It features three astronauts on the moon as they are suddenly jumped by a space monster, which takes them out one by one. The tone is humorous and targets a general audience.

This is a promo for the YouTube channel Bulls Montage. It features an NBA player giving a motivational speech while footage plays of him training intercut with B-Roll of past Chicago Bulls, LA Lakers, and Miami Heat games. The tone is uplifting and targets a basketball audience.

This is an ad for Nike. It features multiple versions of the same pro athlete as a different professional: a golfer, an equestrian, a cricket player, a Formula 1 racer, a surfer, and a football player. The tone is humorous and targets Nike and sports fans in general.

This is an ad for Nike. It features Chris Rock as a trash-talking action figure on the sidelines of a pick-up basketball game, which doesn't faze the player who goes on to perfectly dunk the ball. The tone is humorous and targets Nike and sports fans.

This is an ad for Nike shot in the style of a PSA. It features children urging the camera (a substitute for their parents) to allow them to play sports and reduce the chances of future burdens like teen pregnancy, breast cancer, and domestic violence. The tone is serious and targets parents.

This is a vintage commercial for Folgers Mountain Grown coffee. It features a husband degrading his wife's coffee-making skills. On her friend's recommendation, she tries Folgers, much to his delight. The tone is informative and targets coffee-drinking adults.

This is an ad for General Motors. It features an assembly line machine that is fired due to a minor error. The machine tries to succeed in other jobs only to fail, finally deciding to end its sorrows by jumping off a bridge. Upon doing so, it's revealed that the machine was in a stress-induced daydream, highlighting GM's quality standards and the consequences of not adhering to them. The tone is humorous and targeted towards prospective car buyers.

This is a Russian advertisement for Hell Energy drink. It features a montage of people acting out their passions: painting, playing the piano, training for a fight, running, and surfing. The tone is uplifting and targeted towards a greater Russian audience.

This is a game trailer for the Megaman Legacy Collection. It features six classic Megaman games, their respective improvements, and new additions, all compiled in a single collection for modern gaming hardware. The tone is informative and targets gamers, particularly fans of the Megaman series.

This is an ad for Škoda's Octavia vRS model car. It features suburban residents staring in awe at the passing Octavia vRS. The onlooking residents all have extraordinary items, like a high-powered BBQ grill and a monster ice cream truck, yet their reactions emphasize their items pale in comparison to the Octavia vRS. The tone is informative and humorous and targets car buyers.

This is a South Asian commercial for Mentos. It features a rooster chiding a chick. His diatribe continues until a human hand offers him a Mentos. The end tagline is "biggerrrrrrr, softerrrrrrr, betterrrrrr". The tone is humorous and targets a general South Asian audience.

This is a trailer for London Has Fallen. Starring Gerald Butler as a secret service agent and Morgan Freeman as the American President, the trailer highlights key scenes and set pieces from the film. The tone is exhilarating and targeted towards a mature audience (the film is rated R) and action fans alike.

This is an ad for The Simpsons game for the Nintendo Entertainment System. It features Bart Simpson playing the game late at night while Homer Simpson yells from downstairs for his son to go to bed. The tone is humorous and targets gamers and Simpsons fans alike.

This is a commercial for 5 Gum. It features a young woman as she goes into a tattoo parlor while her friend records. The ad ends as the tattoo gun approaches her, ending with the tagline "Life happens in 5". The tone is cinematic and targets a general audience.

This is an ad for EA Sports' FIFA 14 for Xbox 360 and Xbox One. It features a young man slowly transforming into Lionel Messi after turning on his Xbox One. The tone is informative and targets soccer fans and gamers, particularly those interested in Xbox consoles.

This is an ad for Evian water. It features Andrew Garfield's title character from The Amazing Spider-Man 2 as he encounters and then interacts with his chibi reflection in a mirror. The tone is humorous and targets a general audience.

This is an ad for Gatorade sports drink. It features a montage of different sports, including football, skating, beach volleyball, basketball, tennis, snowboarding, and soccer, associating sports excellence with Gatorade. Its tone is cinematic and targets athletes.

This is an ad for the HTC RE camera. The ad highlights the camera's features such as being waterproof, being able to be handled with one hand, its cinematic presets, and phone connectivity. Its tone is informative and targets a general audience.

This is a seasonal ad for [NBAstore.com](http://NBAstore.com)[.](http://NBAstore.com) It features five NBA players as they shoot free throws into hoops with bells on the nets, producing the melody of Jingle Bells as each ball sinks. The tone is seasonal and targets NBA fans for the holiday season.

This is a vintage ad for Folger's coffee. It features a husband helping  elderly Mrs. Olson with her broken-down car. When he recommends calling a mechanic, his wife offers to make coffee, much to her husband's chagrin. As the wife complains that all coffee is the same, Mrs. Olson recommends and produces a can of Folgers, which they use to make coffee that pleases the husband. The tone is humorous and targets a general audience.

This is a Chinese ad for Huat coffee mix. It features coffee shop patrons who fail to get along until a shop worker serves them Huat coffee, which lifts their spirits enough to literally sing its praises. Its tone is humorous and targets a general Chinese audience.

This is an Indian ad for the Good Knight scent machine. It features a young Indian brother and sister as they flick through the scents on the Good Knight in their bedroom. Its tone is wholesome and targets a general Indian audience.

This is a congressional political ad endorsing conservative candidate Warren Davidson. The ad highlights Davidson's experience as an Army Ranger and successful businessman, among other qualities that make him an attractive candidate. The tone is informative and politically-motivated while targeting voters.

This is an ad for [itsmorefuninthephilippines.com](http://itsmorefuninthephilippines.com), a website that promotes Philippines tourism. It highlights Bohol's 1,776 hills before ending on a beachside resort. The ad's tone is informative and targets international tourists interested in visiting the Philippines.

This is an ad for Quiznos Sub. It features two "creatures" with mouse features as they sing about Quiznos' subs, including the Santa Fe Roast Beef, Chicken, and Smoked Turkey subs. Its tone is surreal and targeted towards sandwich lovers.

This is a political attack ad against Donald Trump by his Republican opponent, Jeb Bush. It features Trump's negative qualities, like his lack of military and public policy experience, while clown music plays in the background. The tone is politically charged and targets Republican primary voters.

This is an ad for Tata Motors' Nano smart car. It features Indian 20-somethings driving around the streets in their Nano smart cars, breaking into song and dance on the streets as they celebrate. The ad's tone is whimsical and targets an Indian audience.

This is an ad for Telecom's telephone services. It features meerkats falling asleep while standing upright, huddled together atop an orange dirt mound. It ends with the Telecom branding and its slogan "Keep In Touch". The ad's tone is humorous and targets a UK audience.

This is an ad for the Truck & Jeep Accessory Superstore 4 Wheel Parts. It features stuntman Mike Escamilla as he speaks on the reliability of his 4-wheeler Jeep, thanks to its quality components. The tone is informative and targets truck and Jeep owners.

This is an Indian ad for Nestlé Fruta Vitals. It features a woman addressing her boyfriend beside her on the couch. He ignores her in favor of his Fruta Vitals drink. It's only after she takes it away from him that he pays attention. The tone is humorous and targets a general Indian audience.

This is a political attack ad against the Australian Liberal Party by the Australian Labor Party. The tone is politically charged and targets the Australian voter base.

This is a political ad by the lobbyist group Grocery Manufacturers Association. It features farmer Jim Jirava giving a testimonial on the importance, safety, and efficacy of GMO crops. It urges constituents to contact their senators and urge them to pass a uniform national food labeling standard. The tone is informative and targets the constituency across the US.

This is an advert for the Ford Sportka. It features the titular car model luring a stray cat onto its sunroof by opening it and leaving it slightly ajar. It's told in a dark, humorous tone and targets prospective car owners.

This is an animated anti-smoking PSA by [thetruth.com](http://thetruth.com)[.](http://thetruth.com) It features an infant in the style of an 8-bit Super Mario-like game as it navigates dangerous levels to escape cigarette smoke. The ad's tone is informative and targets smokers and potential smokers, especially those around small children.

This is an ad for Spin Master's Spy Gear Tri-Optics Video Watch. It highlights the Video Watch's capabilities, like picture/video capture using three zoom presets and video playback. The tone is informative and targets boys in middle school and under.

This is an ad for the Lifeway Kefir. It features a talking moose speaking on the healthy probiotic properties of Lifeway Kefir and how it not only benefits him but every other person and/or thing: a groundhog, a farmer, a pregnant woman (and fetus), and a talking tree. The ad's tone is humorous and targets a general audience.

This is a promo ad for BBC Earth's Earth on Location. It features the host addressing the camera on the show's mission to spot a breaching blue whale, which comically appears as he mentions it. The tone is educational and targets a general audience.

This is an ad for Montana's Cookhouse restaurant. It features two friends praising Montana's range of meats while a coyote -- also a diner -- stares at them (in retaliation for being stared at). The tone is humorous and targets meat lovers.

This is an ad for Reebok. Shot like a Rocky Balboa training montage, it features an NBA player sprinting through the streets of Philadelphia while dribbling a basketball. The tone is uplifting and targets Reebok and basketball fans alike.

Whether savored in a lively tasting room or around a campfire with friends, Angry Orchard is presented as the ideal choice for those seeking something different. The tone remains informative and appeals to cider enthusiasts.

This advertisement promotes Jammie Dodgers biscuits. It shows Jammie, a puppet monkey with a large biscuit on its head, singing a power ballad called "A Certain Gooey Thing." The commercial features Jammie in dramatic scenes, such as playing a white grand piano, singing into a vintage microphone, and shredding an electric guitar with a female co-star also playing guitar. The tone is surreal and musical.

This ASICS ad features two African men walking through a savanna, casually talking about their disinterest in Sandra Bullock. Their chat is suddenly interrupted when they come across a large lion. One man quickly retrieves a pair of ASICS running shoes from his bag and starts to put them on. When his friend asks if he thinks he's faster than a lion, he responds, "No, but I'm faster than you!" The ad concludes with him sprinting away, leaving his amazed friend behind as the lion chases them. The overall tone is humorous.

This Indian Cadbury Dairy Milk commercial highlights the playful yet meaningful bond between siblings. It shows a sister getting ready for her wedding while her brother playfully teases her during family gatherings. Despite their joking, he surprises her with a chocolate bar. The ad ends with a heartfelt scene where she discovers another chocolate bar hidden in her getaway car. The tone is warm and is aimed at a wide Indian audience.

This Snickers commercial stars the legendary Mr. T. When he sees a man speed-walking in a residential neighborhood, he chooses to "help" him run more confidently. Mr. T rides in the back of a truck, shooting Snickers bars from a Gatling gun at the speed-walker. The ad ends with the tagline: "Snickers: Get Some Nuts!" The tone is energetic and humorous.

This animated advertisement promotes the mobile game Battle Camp by parodying the classic Western film "The Good, the Bad and the Ugly." It shows three distinct monster eggs hatching into unique creatures: a griffin-like hero bird, a fiery red beast, and a swamp-dwelling monster. The ad highlights the game's evolution system, in which monsters level up into stronger forms. It ends with a glimpse of social and puzzle gameplay on mobile devices, encouraging players to download the game for free. The tone is educational and aimed at young mobile gamers.

This lively holiday commercial for H&M features Katy Perry as a sparkling Christmas fairy. She performs a remix of "Every Day is a Holiday" in a whimsical winter scene. The ad is rich with holiday symbols, such as dancing gingerbread men, nutcrackers, and large candy canes. It captures the festive spirit with bright costumes and a joyful mood, concluding with an invitation to shop at H&M stores for the holidays. The tone is festive.

This Indian advertisement showcases the Moto G Turbo Edition. It depicts a man and his Golden Retriever playfully giving each other a bath in a brightly colored green bathroom. When the man accidentally drops his phone into the tub, it stays fully operational, enabling him to continue photographing his dog. The ad emphasizes the phone's IP67 water- and dust-resistance. The tone is informative and appeals to a wide Indian audience.

This Wendy’s commercial shows three older women at a "Home of the Big Bun" drive-thru. After getting a burger with an oversized bun and a tiny patty, one woman keeps asking, "Where's the beef?" The ad emphasizes that Wendy's single burger contains more beef than a McDonald's Big Mac or a Burger King Whopper. The tone is lighthearted and humorous.

This Filipino advertisement for Cornetto Black & White ice cream features a man in black holding a cone as he walks along a sidewalk. He encounters a ballerina dressed in white inside a dance studio. When he opens the ice cream wrapper, dubstep music begins to play, prompting them both to start dancing to the beat. The ad has a humorous tone and appeals to a wide Filipino audience.

This ETRADE commercial shows a baby sitting next to a large pile of cash, warning viewers about hidden 401(k) fees. The narrator mentions that if you're eager to spend your money freely, there are many lavish ways to do so, such as sipping champagne in a tuxedo, playing polo, attending high-end auctions, running with bulls, going to space with a dog, or relaxing in a hot tub with a panda and sailing a yacht. The ad ends by presenting ETRADE as a smarter choice with low-cost investments and no hidden fees. Its tone is humorous.

This is an advertisement for Nestlé's Nesfruta "Guyabano" (soursop) flavored beverage. It shows a father and daughter enthusiastically praising the drink as they enjoy it. On-screen text highlights that the drink is made with real fruit and contains 100% of the recommended daily vitamin C. The tone remains informative.

This animated ad for Cadbury's Caramel chocolate bar shows a beaver chewing through a tree trunk as a voluptuous female rabbit approaches, asking if he's tried Cadbury's Caramel. While the rabbit chats and the beaver stares, two squirrels emerge from the tree and struggle to keep it from falling. The tone remains playful and informative.

This is a Geico ad featuring the Pillsbury Dough Boy going through airport security, giggling as he's patted down. Nearby, two folk artists on stage discuss how switching to Geico makes people happier. One responds, "happier than the Pillsbury Dough Boy going to a baking convention." The tone is humorous and aimed at car owners.

The Nestlé Wonder Ball commercial shows children eagerly uncovering surprises inside the hollow chocolate spheres, such as candy shapes and stickers. It features different themed versions, including Toy Story, The Lion King, 101 Dalmatians, and Hercules. The tone is informative and aimed at a young audience.

This is a PSA for [drugfreeworld.org](http://drugfreeworld.org). It begins with a glamorous portrayal of a woman’s party lifestyle but quickly transitions to scenes depicting physical and emotional suffering, including an emergency room visit due to her cocaine use. The message ends with the woman sitting alone in a hospital, encouraging viewers to "find out the truth about cocaine." The tone is serious and informative.

This FIFA 14 commercial showcases a global community of gamers taking part in an extensive desert-themed festival. A red van with a satellite dish and multiple screens leads a procession of fans who are playing the game from sofas, beds, and even specialized vehicles. The ad features cameos from well-known celebrities and athletes, including Lionel Messi, Drake, Gareth Bale, Tim Howard, and Stephan El Shaarawy. It emphasizes the game's immersive gameplay and social aspects, concluding with the slogan "We are FIFA 14" and details about pre-ordering for Xbox 360. The tone remains informative and exciting.

This cinematic commercial humorously parodies luxury car ads to promote a beloved 1996 Nissan Maxima GLE. The narrator calls the car an iconic monument that has survived "wars and depression." Despite its age and wear, such as a torn leather seat and a bumper held on with a strap, the ad playfully emphasizes its "monumental perfection" and its ability to get you from point A to B "most of the time." The tone is tongue-in-cheek.

This vintage commercial for High Technology, Inc. introduces the Apple II, calling it the "easy to operate home computer." The ad highlights its versatility, showing how users can connect it to a TV for vibrant color displays, balance a checkbook, help children learn arithmetic, and invent or play custom video games like "Pong." It refers to the device as the "first personal computer" and emphasizes that the possibilities are endless for families using this new technology. The tone is informative.

This is an advertisement for CoverGirl. In a segment titled "Glamour," New York celebrity makeup artist Virginia Linzee discusses her approach and philosophy when applying makeup to celebrity clients. She emphasizes the importance of understanding her client's personality and desired look, and of considering paparazzi lighting. The tone is informative and aimed at women.

This is a Doritos advertisement. It shows a man finishing a bag of Doritos on a park bench when a conventionally attractive woman walks by and asks if that was the last one. When the man confirms, she straddles him and licks his face to get Dorito residue. The tone is suggestive and aimed at a wide audience.

This is a trailer for Portal 2, showcasing the titular robots wielding portal guns to shoot at flat surfaces and enter and exit through portals, bending physics and reality. The tone is informative and aimed at gamers, particularly fans of the original Portal game.

This German-language trailer for the disaster film The Day After Tomorrow, distributed by 20th Century Fox, includes a montage of scenes from the movie. It provides a brief overview: the world faces catastrophic weather events that devastate modern civilization. The tone is cinematic and engaging, appealing to disaster film enthusiasts.

This ad for Geico car insurance includes a testimonial with Alex Klein, a real customer, and Michael Winslow, a celebrity known for his sound effects. Klein shares his experience of an accident and how Geico quickly issued a check for damages in under 10 business hours, with Winslow performing sound effects to highlight the story. The tone is humorous and aimed at car owners.

This series of ads for Bubble Yum includes the first, featuring a young Black boy sitting on a beach chair, blowing a Bubble Yum bubble while a tortoise stands in front of him. The second ad features a young Leonardo DiCaprio talking about Bubble Yum in front of a giant speaker setup that bursts when he pops his bubble gum. The tone is informative and aimed at a young audience.

This advertisement promotes Everlast boxing gear. It shows a young boxer training intensely while his brother observes. Eventually, he enters a match and wins easily. After leaving, they face a mugger on their way home. The mugger demands their money, and the young boxer simply hands it over. When his younger brother asks why he didn't fight the mugger, he replies, "Because he is hungry." The ad ends with the message "boxing makes you bigger." The tone is inspirational and aimed at boxers.

This is an ad for DC Shoes featuring a famous skateboarder being chased by a crowd of female fans through city streets. He successfully escapes by performing intricate and impressive skateboard tricks. The tone is light-hearted and exciting, aimed at skateboard enthusiasts.

This anti-piracy PSA shows a teenage girl downloading a pirated film on her computer, highlighting the illegality of piracy. It also includes a montage of crime scenes involving thefts of a handbag, a television, and a car. The tone is cautionary, aimed at discouraging piracy.

This ad for the Volkswagen Polo shows a suicide bomber casually driving to a busy restaurant, parking, and pressing the detonation device. The explosion is contained within the vehicle, avoiding harm to nearby bystanders. The tone is provocative and not politically correct, aimed at potential Volkswagen customers.

This is a tourism advertisement for the Hawaiian Islands. Set on O'ahu, it follows a man on vacation who repeatedly encounters a blonde woman. They eventually join each other for nighttime surfing while watching fireworks, and end up covered in sand on the beach as they fall asleep, with little kids burying them. The tone is romantic and aimed at attracting potential visitors to Hawaii.

This is an Indian Pepsi advertisement depicting a snake charmer being teased by girls passing by. Using his snake flute, he makes bottles of Pepsi move in a snake-like sequence. The girls seem unimpressed and ignore him, but the snake charmer spots a Pepsi bottle design on one girl's shirt. He uses his flute to lift it, revealing her belly, and then removes it. The ad has a playful tone and appeals to a wide Indian audience.

This Knorr promotional video showcases a recipe for "pavo navideño" (Christmas turkey in Spanish) using Knorr's chicken broth. It details all the ingredients with measurements and outlines the steps to prepare the dish. The tone is informative and aimed at Hispanic home cooks.

This is an advertisement for Finish Line. It shows basketball star Anthony Davis, who initially looks sweaty after a game, then disrobes and leaves in his regular clothes. He is escorted by security and walks out into a room filled with flashing cameras. The tone is motivational, aimed at basketball fans.

This is an advertisement for Gatorade featuring Michael Jordan engaging in a one-on-one pickup game against his younger self, dressed in his red 23 Chicago Bulls uniform. This advertisement for Havells wires is set in an urban swamp environment. It depicts a Muslim father and daughter, where the father attempts and fails to chop firewood. The overall tone of the ad is informative.

This is an advertisement for Dick's Sporting Goods. It showcases a montage of young athletes, including baseball, softball, lacrosse, football, soccer, and golf players training, exercising, and playing their sports. Motivational music plays in the background, concluding with the message, "Every Season Starts At Dick's Sporting Goods." The tone is inspiring and aimed at athletes.

This series of Burger King ads features Dell Curry and his young son, Stephen Curry, walking through a park. This is a political lobbying ad for the [vote4energy.org](http://vote4energy.org) campaign, funded by the American Petroleum Institute. The message is politically charged and aimed at voters.

This is a promotional video for Prada's Spring Summer 2012 collection. It showcases models posing in the collection's clothing and accessories. The theme and era shift each time the car's radio changes stations and the song's genre shifts. The video has a stylish tone and is aimed at a high-fashion audience.

This is a Canadian PSA addressing bullying. Set in a high school classroom, it shows a female student, Jenna, being teased for excelling academically. Mean notes are passed to her, the most recent reading "Real nice Kiss-Ass." The tone is serious, aimed at Canadian school-aged youth.

This ad promotes Sit'n Sleep, claimed to be Southern California's top mattress retailer. It shows scenes inside the store where experienced sales associates assist customers in choosing their ideal mattress, utilizing technology to match customers with the perfect bed. The tone is informative and aimed at residents of Southern California.

This ad is for Facebook. It shows an animated, contemporary version of Little Red Riding Hood. Little Red Riding Hood accepts a friend request on social media from the wolf. The wolf is shown stalking Grandma, who is playing video games in her living room, before Little Red Riding Hood arrives. The final scene is of Grandma shooting the wolf, who is impersonating her in front of the television. The ad warns the viewer that they should only accept friend requests from people they know. This ad promotes Knocker Ball, a large inflatable wearable ball. It shows players participating in activities such as Knocker flips, Knocker rolls, Knocker soccer, and knocking each other out. The tone is informative and aimed at active adults.

This is an advertisement for Theravent, depicting a husband's loud snoring that wakes his wife and disrupts her sleep. The scene then shows the Theravent product in use, with a male narrator explaining its benefits, how to wear it, and the anticipated outcomes. The tone is informative and aimed at heavy snorers.

This is an advertisement for Diet Coke featuring singer-songwriter Taylor Swift. She is shown sitting on her bedroom floor writing her latest song, occasionally sipping from a Diet Coke. As she reads each lyric aloud, the scene cuts to shots of other people singing the same song. The tone is playful and aimed at fans of Diet Coke and Taylor Swift.

This is a brief trailer for London Has Fallen, starring Gerard Butler and Morgan Freeman. It includes a montage of key action scenes and set pieces, highlighting the plot: a plan to kidnap the president. The tone is cinematic and thrilling, designed to appeal to action movie enthusiasts.

This cinematic trailer for Ubisoft's Far Cry Primal showcases the game's prehistoric setting, characters, combat, and tone, ending with its branding, release date, and launch availability on game consoles. This New Zealand ad for Instant Kiwi is set in a college classroom. It shows a male student finishing his exam early and then scratching a lottery ticket as the professor gives a one-minute warning. When the professor says no, the student replies "good," shoves his exam into the pile, and walks away quickly. The overall tone is humorous.

This is a commercial for Faygo. It shows passengers on a ferry singing a cheerful song about Faygo, while they drink the beverage. The ad concludes with a wide shot of the ferry at sunset and the Faygo logo. The tone is lively and warm, appealing to a wide audience.

This advertisement for Meow Mix shows a cat "meowing" along to the Meow Mix jingle, with sing-along lyrics displayed at the bottom. It highlights two flavors: Original and Seafood Middles. The tone is informative, playful, and aimed at cat owners.

This is an advertisement for the Academy Sports + Outdoors store. It features first-person shots of children engaging in outdoor activities with their fathers, such as hiking, throwing footballs, fishing, biking, and camping. The tone is warm and appeals to outdoor enthusiasts.

This tourism ad for Lubbock, West Texas, features residents and business owners highlighting the city's reputation as a key wine-producing region. It notes that eighty percent of Texas wine grapes are grown in the South Plains, home to award-winning wineries and acclaimed winemakers. Visitors are invited to sample wine directly from the barrel or share a bottle with others. The ad positions Lubbock as an ideal getaway for wine enthusiasts, using an informative tone to attract tourists.

This Monster Energy advertisement features the band Diecast, sitting tired inside a house before they go on stage. They look exhausted and low on energy when two girls walk in holding cans of Monster Energy and say, “Hey, Diecast, wanna pick me up?” The band members then crush open the cans and drink them, instantly becoming energized and excited. The commercial cuts to them performing on stage with intense energy, playing rock music, and engaging the crowd. It ends with the Monster Energy logo, emphasizing the drink as the source of their energy boost.

This vintage ad for The International House of Pancakes, now called IHOP, shows a chipmunk-like voice singing about IHOP. It depicts a family with big helium balloons running toward the restaurant, set in a wooded area. The overall tone is cheerful.

This is a Japanese advertisement for Mario Kart DS on the Nintendo DS handheld console. It shows a Japanese man dressed as Luigi competing in online Mario Kart matches, often losing to international players from France, the US, and Italy. The tone is humorous and aimed at a Japanese audience.

This is a Sprite advertisement featuring a nude Caucasian woman on her knees in a kitchen, simulating oral sex with a dark-skinned man while thinking about wanting a Sprite. After she pulls her mouth away, a Sprite bottle explodes on her face and chest. The tone is provocative.

This Knorr advertisement shows how to make a pasta salad with vegetables. This advertisement for Pizza Hut begins with a group of friends dining in when one of them asks the waiter if they have a cheeseburger. Sure.” A voice in the background then announces the new Cheeseburger Crown Crust Pizza as Pizza Hut’s new masterpiece. The commercial ends with the Pizza Hut logo and slogan. This ad is for the Audi A3 TDI clean diesel. This ad is for the Crystal Judson Family Justice Center. It shows a couple getting married saying their vows at the altar. The Pachelbel Canon is playing in the background. This ad is for Coca Cola. It shows a group of young boys entering a recording studio. They open a bottle of coca cola and begin making music. This advertisement is for Northwell Health. It begins by showing close-up shots of different people’s eyes, then switches between scenes of patients, hospitals, and medical staff at work. At the end, it announces that North Shore-LIJ Health System is now Northwell Health and displays the slogan “Look North.” The tone of the advertisement is informative.

This ad is for Burger King. It shows a cartoon customer ordering various food items, such as a shake and fries, and the worker turning the customer into that food item. The worker says at the end "Nobody's perfect." The tone of the ad is humorous and lighthearted.

This is an advertisement for Roto-Rooter Plumbing & Drain Service, featuring footage of leaking faucets, spouts, pipes, roofs, and showerheads. The leaks start small and gradually grow larger, eventually becoming massive, high-pressure leaks. The tone is informative.

This is a political ad for Ronald Reagan's presidential reelection campaign. The tone is informative and aimed at voters.

This ad is for Tootsie Roll. It shows an animated boy who inquires of various animals how many licks it takes to get to the center of a Tootsie Pop. The final animal the boy asks is an owl. The smart owl takes three bites and finishes the Tootsie Pop, much to the boy's dismay. The tone of the ad is humorous and heartwarming.

This ad is for Motorola Motoyuva w230. It shows a teenager in the kitchen and his father scolding him loudly from another room for not putting away his cricket gear. The son begins to argue but then gives up, plugging into his phone which is playing music. The father does not realize he is being tuned out. The tone of the ad is comical.

An advertisement for Geico shows a woman talking about her car accident while a trio of musicians provide sound effects. The ad features a 'real Geico customer' named Tara, who says that she was in a car accident, due to Geico, the repair shop and rental services were available to her, and her rates remained the same. Between these two statements, the Pips, a music group, sing phrases to emphasize her point, such as "fender bender", "rental car smells like sunshine", and "take a train to happy town". It highlights that Geico offers "real service" and "real savings".

An advertisement for the Smart Fortwo shows a series of scenes where people in the front seat of cars are attacked by people in the backseat of the car. It highlights that backseats are dangerous, and the car has none.

This ad is for Kandoo flushable wipes. The ad shows a male toddler playing dress up in his bedroom saying "Daddy, I did it" and the dad walking into the room smiling. The same toddler is shown on the toilet making a mess with toilet paper. The ad then cuts to the boy flushing a wipe down the toilet after he has used the bathroom. An advertisement for Commercial Bank shows a man flicking a magazine to make the car on the page appear. The ad features a man looking through a catalog, then steps on a step stool, where he flicks the magazine towards the road in front of him to make the car on the page appear. This Australian advertisement for [howsafeisyourcar.com.au](http://howsafeisyourcar.com.au) is set in a car warehouse. It shows an Australian man selecting cars he considers viable, emphasizing that if a new or used car doesn't have ASC and side head airbags, it should be rejected for safety reasons and poor resale value. The tone is informative and aimed at Australian car buyers.

This is a story trailer for EA Sports' FIFA 17: The Journey video game. It features protagonist Alex Hunter as he embarks on his journey, beginning in the Premier League and rising to football superstardom, facing various trials and tribulations along the way. The tone is cinematic and aimed at FIFA fans.

An advertisement for The Chalk Talk Mug shows a black mug being drawn on, cleaned, and used like a normal mug. The ad features a normal mug being poured into, the chalk-ridden mug being presented with drawings of a face, heart, tic-tac-toe, and different phrases. Lastly it features a scene of a man coughing white dust after drinking from the mug as the voiceover notes that it only recommends "marking the outside of the cup". This ad is for Hasbro's Littlest PetShop Shuttle. It shows a child's hand playing with the pink shuttle, which is carrying several pets. One pet slides down a green slide. This ad is for Mastercard. It shows two teenagers holding hands approaching a house at night, after a date. They arrive at her porch as a male voiceover says "A night on the town, 75 dollars." The porch light comes on and the girl's sister comes to the door and says that their dad says the daughter can do it, the sister can do it, or even he himself would do it, but the boy should take his hand off the intercom.  The voiceover says that having a dad with a sense of humor is priceless but for everything else there is Mastercard. The tone of the ad is comical.

This is an advertisement for Newcastle Brown Ale. It showcases American football player Keyshawn Johnson explaining "The Mega Huge Football Game Ad Newcastle Brown Ale Almost Made," a commercial they never produced because of budget limitations. He recaps the commercial's concept and early storyboards. The tone is humorous and aimed at ale enthusiasts.

An advertisement for Bridgestone shows a Mercedes-Benz car stopping in time to avoid hitting a dog that jumped in front of it to end its own life. The ad features the same dog wagging its tail as it walks down the street with a bone in its mouth when it encounters a bulldog on top of a poodle. An advertisement for ... shows an office worker pulled outside the office on a fishing hook to smoke. The ad features the worker hanging up a phone after a call while surrounded by coworkers. This Indian advertisement for Cadbury's Rich Dry Fruit Chocolate is set during Diwali. It shows four soldiers in the Indian military, with one of their wives and in-laws, surprising him at his base to celebrate by offering Cadbury's Rich Dry Fruit Chocolate. The tone is warm and festive, appealing to a wide Indian audience.

This is a trailer for Max Payne 3, developed by Rockstar Games. It showcases in-game cutscenes, shootouts, military weapons & vehicles, explosive scenes and chaos throughout. The tone is exciting and aimed at mature gamers, especially fans of Rockstar games.

This brief 5-second ad for Bernie Sanders' 2016 presidential campaign features a male narrator asking, "Want real change? When the car comes back, cookies shaped like the Mercedes logo are baked into the engine, and the hood is inspected. The ad is humorous and festive, aimed at Mercedes racing fans.

This Swedish PSA against alcohol abuse is set in a pub. It begins as a whiskey commercial for the fictional Taman brand, parodying a Jameson ad, before shifting to discuss statistics on alcohol abusers in Sweden and their outcomes. The tone is reflective and informative, targeting Swedish audiences.

This is an Indian ad for Kit Kat by Nestle. It features a young college student using his computer on a park bench. This advertisement showcases the Tesla Model S with a family on a road trip, the vehicle driven and recharged at free solar-powered stations.
