This is a vintage Indian advertisement for the car brand Peugeot. It shows an Indian man deliberately damaging a regular car by crashing it head-on and rear-ending it, smashing it with a hammer, and even having an elephant sit on it. The purpose is to transform it into a Peugeot 206, which still looks dinged up. The tone is humorous and aimed at Indian drivers.

This Australian Nutella ad shows a family waking up and enjoying breakfast together, with Nutella providing energy for their day. The ad highlights activities such as swimming, playing, and dancing at a school recital. It has a warm, informative tone aimed at a general Australian audience.

This UK advertisement for Robinson's Double Concentrate Orange juice shows two brothers spending the day together, playing and enjoying each other's company. In the evening, the older brother carries the younger to bed, only to be revealed as the child's father, now appearing as an adult. The tone is warm and wholesome, aimed at a wide English audience.

This is a Coca-Cola advertisement featuring the Coca-Cola polar bear mascots. In the scene, one bear leaves his cave to join his friends, who toss him a Coke bottle. He catches it, but then slides quickly on the ice. His friends attempt to slow him down to prevent him from falling, but their efforts cause them to bump into each other and fall. The ad has a playful tone and appeals to a wide audience.

This advertisement showcases bodypainting artist Johannes Stötter. It depicts a giant wolf howling, which is revealed to be composed of three painted models arranged strategically to resemble a wolf. The tone is informative and artistic, aimed at those seeking a body painter.

This is a video advertisement for the GoPro HERO4. Filmed with a GoPro positioned in front of an owl nest, it shows two owlets approaching the camera and moving their necks rhythmically, resembling dancing, while club music plays in the background to enhance this effect. The tone is humorous and intended for a wide audience.

This ad is for Lotte brand gum called "Fits." It shows a young girl singing a song in Japanese and dancing in front of two large statues of warriors in the background, in what appears to be a tourist site. The girl takes a piece of gum out of the package. Eventually, another girl joins in and a dressed up character appears in the background dancing. The Fits gum is shown again in 4 different flavors. The ad restarts with a boy also dancing to the same tune and then appearing in a bucolic scene with another girl who is feeding a deer. Again, a dressed up character appears and starts dancing and then 4 flavors of gum are shown. The sequence is repeated. The tone of the ad is comical.

This promotional video by Nucleus Medical Art presents a computer-generated depiction of a person inhaling cigarettes, highlighting the harmful impact of smoking on lung health. The tone is informative, illustrative, and artistic, aimed at smokers or individuals considering smoking.

This is an infomercial for Alfonso's Breakin' & Poppin' Book, starring young dancer Alfonso Ribeiro. He introduces the book, which teaches kids and teens how to perform both simple and advanced dance moves. The package also includes a large breakdancing board and a rap album. The tone is informative, aimed at children interested in learning to dance.

This is a vintage advertisement for the Xerox 914 copier. It shows a young female secretary telling the camera that she isn't responsible for typical secretary tasks like taking dictation, filing, or sharpening pencils. Despite this, her boss calls her indispensable because of her skill in making perfect copies on the Xerox machine, which is praised as so easy to operate that even dimwitted secretaries could do it. The tone is informative and aimed at office workers.

This ad promotes the book Where Do Brothers Come From. It features Zac Efron and Adam Devine as their characters, Mike and Dave Stangle, from the movie Mike & Dave Need Wedding Dates. They read passages from a seemingly innocent adult "children's" book, revealing it is intended for a mature audience. The tone is humorous and aimed at adults.

This PlayStation 2 ad depicts a young deer frolicking in the woods as a driver passes by on a nearby road. The deer attempts to cross the road and encounters an oncoming vehicle, but instead of being hit, the car absorbs the impact, denting severely as if the deer were an immovable object. The on-screen text reads "Different Place, Different Rules." The tone is humorous and aimed at gamers.

This ad promotes Hahn Premium Light beer through a humorous scene set at a coastal pool party in Europe. It shows a woman in a bikini relaxing by the pool while enjoying a Hahn. Suddenly, a man leaps from a second-story balcony onto the cushion where the woman was sitting, causing her to fall into the pool and casually drink her Hahn. The tone is playful and aimed at beer enthusiasts.

This is a public service announcement from the Newton County District Attorney's Office addressing domestic violence. It shows women and children holding signs that reference domestic violence, such as "we're scared he's going to kill mommy," "I can't afford to get out," and a male victim with a sign stating "we're not always the aggressors." The message is serious and informative, encouraging Newton County residents to seek help.

This is a GoPro advertisement set in a film studio. It offers a behind-the-scenes glimpse of the film crew preparing and filming a complex GoPro commercial, during which the camera is exposed to elements such as dirt, snow, paintballs, and water, yet remains unaffected. The tone is playful and cinematic, aimed at action camera enthusiasts.

This is a South Korean McDonald's ad featuring a woman and a young boy, each at separate tables, enjoying a chocolate-covered ice cream cone. The boy glances back at the woman sitting behind him, and she playfully points to his chocolate-smudged face with her tongue. He innocently interprets this as her sticking her tongue out at him, and he responds in kind. The ad's tone is playful and aimed at a broad South Korean audience.

This is an advertisement for Old Spice Pro Strength deodorant. It shows Neil Patrick Harris dressed as a doctor, recalling his earlier role as kid doctor Doogie Howser, as he moves through a hospital set talking to the audience about the clinically proven, prescription-strength Old Spice Pro Strength deodorant. The tone is playful and informative, targeting men seeking a more effective deodorant.

This ad promotes Melo, Carmelo Anthony's Nike sneakers. It shows Anthony training, performing drills, managing his business, and celebrating his Puerto Rican roots by visiting family on the island. The tone is inspiring and uplifting, aimed at Carmelo Anthony fans.

This is a political attack ad for Barry Goldwater from Lyndon B. Johnson's presidential campaign. It shows a young girl eating an ice cream cone as a female narrator discusses how nuclear testing caused harmful effects and deaths near testing sites, how it was eventually prohibited by an international treaty, and how the upcoming candidate, Barry Goldwater, opposed the treaty. The ad warns that if Goldwater is elected, he might restart nuclear testing. The tone is informative and pessimistic, aimed at persuading voters to support Lyndon B. Johnson.

This Australian PSA about AIDS by the NACAIDS organization depicts ordinary people—men, women, and children—standing in a line like bowling pins while a grim reaper figure launches large bowling balls at them. This imagery illustrates the mortality rate of AIDS and emphasizes that anyone can be affected, not just gay men and IV drug users. The tone is somber and cautionary, aimed at a broad Australian audience.

This is a silent advertisement for Virgin TV, a UK-based digital pay cable service. It showcases the range of programming available on Virgin TV, including the golf tournament The Open, the movie Deadpool, the reality TV series Keeping Up with the Kardashians, and children's shows like The Lion Guard. The tone is informative and tailored for a UK audience.

This is an advertisement for Ellesse performance shoes. It shows close-up shots of a woman's body as she exhales and groans suggestively, only to reveal she was playing tennis against a male opponent. The ad concludes with the Ellesse logo and the tagline "For play," a clever pun on "foreplay." The tone is playful and aimed at athletic audiences.

This is an ad for Mario & Sonic at the London 2012 Olympic Games on the Wii. It shows Mario and Sonic having dinner at Buckingham Palace with British royalty, whose servant introduces them humorously as "the mustachioed man who led the rescue of the princess and the blue-haired one who might want to see the crown jewels and is an avid ring collector." The tone is humorous and aimed at Mario and Sonic fans.

This ad is for Specialized bicycles. It shows Andy Schleck and Alberto Contador in racing gear in a split frame riding stationary bicycles. The two athletes are bantering back and forth about their achievements, trying to prove they are better than the other. The friendly argument culminates with an outlandish story about one of them taking down a bear. The tone of the ad is comical.

The advertisement for Center Shock chewing gum has a humorous tone and begins with a man walking into a barber shop holding a magazine, asking the barber to give him the same haircut as the one shown in the picture. Instead of immediately cutting his hair, the barber hands him a piece of Center Shock gum. As soon as the man starts chewing, he begins shaking his head uncontrollably from the gum’s intense sour flavor. After the shaking stops, his hair somehow transforms to look exactly like the hairstyle in the magazine, creating a funny and exaggerated ending.

This advertisement promotes author Gordon Korman's young-adult novel series, Masterminds. It shows a man warning the audience while footage of a scientist discussing "Project Osiris" plays, hinting at genetically engineered children raised in a lab. The tone is engaging and informative, aimed at young readers.

This ad is for Kinder Surprise by Ferrero. It shows Humpty Dumpty with a blurry, distorted face sitting on a wall unwrapping a Kinder Surprise. He shows that there is a toy inside. Several toys are displayed on the wall where he is sitting. Text on the screen says that batteries are not included. The ad is strange and characteristic of a hallucinogenic trip.

This is an Indian advertisement for the 2016 Hyundai Verna. It shows a couple leaving work while driving through the city, with onscreen text highlighting the car's features such as the 3 Years Unlimited KMs Warranty, Smart Touch Infotainment System, and its segment-first 6 airbags and power. The tone is informative, aimed at a wide Indian audience.

This advertisement for Brandon Honda features owner John Marazzi discussing their Honda inventory, highlighting low prices and financing options, such as a 2016 Honda Civic for $119 per month and a 2016 Honda Accord for $129 per month. The tone is informative and aimed at car buyers in Florida.

This is an Indonesian advertisement for Nippon Paint. It highlights Nippon Paint's color customization service, where customers select a color palette and use the Color Creations paint mixer machine to create the ideal shade. The tone is playful and informative, appealing to a wide Indonesian audience.

This vintage Indian ad for Cadbury's Dairy Milk chocolate bars shows a montage of everyday Indians, both young and old, happily going about their day while enjoying their Cadbury's chocolates. The tone is warm and inspiring, aimed at a wide Indian audience.

This is a humorous ad for Orbit gum. It shows a man at his desk, bumping shoulders with his female assistant, just before his wife bursts in after catching them. Everyone speaks in euphemisms instead of curse words, emphasizing the fresh, clean feeling associated with Orbit. The ad aims to be funny and appeal to a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for the Chambong champagne glass from [Vat19.com](http://Vat19.com). It highlights the Chambong's unique features, such as its bent stem and the ability to drink from the other end instead of the rim, mimicking a marijuana bong. The tone is humorous and appeals to fans of novelty items.

This is an ad for Coach Up. It features Stephen Curry reading his 2009 draft report, which claimed he was a below-average prospect, an assessment later proven wrong by his 2015 MVP award and world champion title. The video includes footage of him performing basketball drills. The tone is inspiring and aimed at basketball fans and individuals seeking one-on-one coaching.

This tourism ad for Dubai features a young girl narrating in the first person, expressing her experience of embodying Dubai's spirit. As she speaks, a montage showcases the city's landscapes, people, and attractions, including windsurfing and horse racing. The tone is cinematic and informative, designed to encourage tourists to visit Dubai.

This tourism ad for Dubai features a young girl narrating in the first person, expressing her experience of embodying Dubai's spirit. As she speaks, a montage showcases the city's landscapes, people, and attractions, including windsurfing and horse racing. The tone is cinematic and informative, designed to encourage tourists to visit Dubai.

This ad promotes Tide's To Go bleach stick. It shows a man during a job interview, with his voice overlaid by a distracting sound coming from a coffee stain on his shirt lapel. The tone is humorous and appeals to a wide audience, especially people who often get stains on their clothes.

This ad for Rebel highlights its extensive inventory of soccer shoes and jerseys, branding itself as the "Home to the biggest range of European jerseys.' It features various team jerseys and adidas boots, appealing to soccer fans with an informative tone.

This is an animated trailer for the film Bilal. It showcases scenes from the movie, including the main characters Bilal, his brother, and his mother, as it narrates the story of the Islamic faith's origins. The tone is cinematic, informative, and family-friendly, aimed at a broad audience, particularly Muslims.

This is an ad for Welch's grape juice, featuring a young boy speaking directly to the camera about its qualities. He highlights that the juice is made from 100% real concord grapes and contains no unhealthy additives commonly found in other brands. The tone is informative and appeals to grape juice enthusiasts.

This advertisement for Boddingtons pale ale depicts a runner speeding across a desolate desert to reach an ice cream truck. Instead of ice cream, the female driver offers him a pint of Boddingtons. The tone is energetic and cinematic, appealing to fans of pale ales.

This is a brief advertisement for the Fujifilm Instax Mini 8 cameras. It showcases the cameras taking photos that develop instantly and highlights the variety of colors available. The tone is informative and cinematic, aimed at casual photographers and those who enjoy the novelty of shooting film.

This is an ad for the mobile game Candy Crush Soda. It shows a woman in a laundromat matching three purple laundry detergents, which releases a trapped gummy bear from inside a washing machine, flooding the entire laundromat with colorful water and candies. The tone is humorous and informative, appealing to a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for [Mayfair.com](http://Mayfair.com). It shows a woman speaking directly to the camera, describing the website's furniture buying and selling process. She highlights it as a convenient and affordable way for homeowners to purchase branded furniture at discounts of up to 70%. The tone is informative and aimed at homeowners.

This is an advertisement for Franco-American's Sonic Pasta. It shows teenage boy Sean engrossed in his Sonic the Hedgehog game, fixated on his TV while his mother calls him for lunch. When he ignores her calls, she throws a can of pasta at him, which Sean catches effortlessly without looking. The tone is humorous and informative, aimed at Sonic fans.

This is an advertisement from the Pew Trust about illegal fishing. It features Jim Toomey, who explains what illegal fishing is and describes various forms, such as using banned fishing methods, exceeding fishing quotas, or fishing without a license or by forging one. The tone is educational and aimed at a general audience.

This ad for Flying Horse energy drink features a man in a house with insufficient electricity, manually cranking a generator to produce a moderate amount of power. After buttering a piece of toast, which always falls butter side down regardless of how it's positioned, he tests the "cats always land on their feet" myth by trying it out on his cat. He then tapes a buttered toast to his cat's back, butter side up, and drops the cat. According to the classic rules, the cat-toast combo spins in a self-sustaining cycle. The man then places the cat into a generator, which quickly powers his home and the entire neighborhood. The tone is humorous and appeals to a broad audience.

This is an advertisement for BMW. It shows a BMW driving quickly across a barren wasteland, passing by a giant glass apple figure, three large water balloons, and a cardboard target, all in slow motion. The tone is cinematic and aimed at BMW enthusiasts.

This is an advertisement for [Seamless.com](http://Seamless.com), an online food ordering platform. It shows a montage of restaurants preparing dishes, followed by scenes of the website's interface, highlighting how users can browse and order from various restaurants with ease. The tone is informative and designed to appeal to a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for Toshiba's sensor technology, showcasing its products and applications in the healthcare sector. It highlights wearable heart-monitoring sensors and diagnostic imaging systems, which are claimed to be installed in hospitals in over 135 countries. The tone remains informative, aimed at a health-conscious audience.

This is an ad for Dollar Shave Club, an online men's grooming service. It shows Mike, the founder, explaining that for just $1 a month, customers receive new blades delivered right to their door, saving them over $20 on name brands. The tone is informative and aimed at potential tourists.

This is an ad for the mobile action game Blade: Sword of Elysion. It showcases a cinematic sequence featuring a male warrior who dual-wields swords to battle a horde of skeleton soldiers, demon ladies, and ultimately a fiery lava-like demon. The tone is thrilling and dramatic, aimed at mobile gamers.

This is a Spanish advertisement for Skin Fruit Flavored condoms. It shows a young couple getting intimate while the girl's parents are away. Just as the girl's parents return, the boyfriend pulls out a packet of fruit-flavored condoms. When asked what he's holding, he disguises it by putting the condom in his mouth and blowing a bubble, acting as if it's bubblegum. The tone is humorous and aimed at sexually active people.

This is a commercial for the Samsung Galaxy S6 Edge and S6 Edge+. It shows an English TV personality being introduced to the basics of rugby by England's rugby team, though he appears overwhelmed and struggles to keep up. The tone is humorous and aimed at a wide English audience, especially rugby fans.

This is an Indian advertisement for Johnson's Baby Milk Lotion. It shows an Indian woman in traditional attire dancing in a temple-like room, while her baby walks towards her, feeling the smooth skin where she had applied the lotion. The tone is wholesome and appeals to a broad Indian audience.

This is an advertisement for Walt Disney World. It shows siblings staying awake at night, too excited to sleep, talking about what Disney World will be like. They are then caught by their mother and told to go back to sleep. The scene cuts to a montage of Disney World's attractions. The tone is friendly and informative, appealing to a wide audience.

This Australian ad for Hahn Premium Light beer shows a woman enjoying a relaxing bath with a sensual tone. Suddenly, her husband jumps in with a cannonball, drinking Hahn's Premium Light beer and remaining unfazed. The ad transitions from sensual to humorous, appealing to Australian beer drinkers.

This is an Indian commercial for Asian Paints. It shows a married couple, with the husband, a Captain, dressed in a military uniform, settling into their home on a military base. The wife is impressed by the beautifully painted walls in their room, which the husband personally decorated for her. The tone is warm and wholesome, aimed at a wide Indian audience.

This is an advertisement for Banks Chevrolet Cadillac Buick GMC dealership. It features a male narrator explaining that, regardless of how customers find them, whether by Googling, reading reviews online, or hearing about them through word of mouth, their dealership is among the most trusted in the New England region. The tone is informative and aimed at New England residents.

This ad promotes the Fortune Cookie Maker by Moose, a toy company. The ad emphasizes how simple it is to use and the high-quality results it delivers. The tone remains informative and is aimed at a younger audience.

This is an advertisement for the Aston Martin DBS, filmed in a desaturated style. It showcases the car driving through scenic countryside, embodying luxury, elegance, and spirit. The cinematic tone appeals to upscale car enthusiasts and connoisseurs.

This is an advertisement for Wildcat Energy Drink. It shows a young man purchasing a Wildcat can and, after opening it, is approached by three women dressed in tiger-print bikinis, tiger ears, and face paint. They then playfully attack him for his drink. The tone is flirtatious and fun, aimed at a young male audience.

This is a game trailer for EA's Battlefield 1 on Xbox One. It showcases cinematics and gameplay depicting intense war scenes across different eras and locations, from medieval Arabian settings to early 20th-century Europe and modern warfare. The tone is thrilling and cinematic, aimed at FPS enthusiasts.

This is a Filipino ad promoting Cornetto's Mango Tango frozen dessert. It shows a young man attempting to impress a girl by buying her tulips. He hands a dollar to the shopkeeper, but since tulips cost 20 Filipino pesos, the shopkeeper kisses the young man twice on the cheek instead. The tone is cheerful and aimed at a wide Filipino audience.

This is an advertisement for Michael Frayn's Broadway show Noises Off, directed by Jeremy Herrin. It highlights reviews from several reputable publications, such as the New York Times, which calls it "Hilarious," and The Huffington Post, describing it as "Slam-Bang Knockdown" funny. The tone is informative and aimed at Broadway enthusiasts.

This is an ad for Bud Light, showing two sushi chefs sending out the "Apology Bot 3000" to a table of customers. The robot apologizes for serving blowfish that was improperly prepared and still contained dangerous levels of poison. As compensation, the robot offers bottles of Bud Light. The overall tone is humorous and aimed at Bud Light drinkers.

This cinematic trailer for Ubisoft's Assassin's Creed showcases the master assassin Altair as he kills a Templar in broad daylight. He then escapes through parkour, blending with monks dressed in similar robes. The tone is cinematic, appealing to stealth game enthusiasts.

This is a McDonald's ad promoting their Filet-o-Fish sandwich. It shows a singing fish head on a wall demanding its owner, who is eating a Filet-o-Fish, return the sandwich, asking what it would be like if he were up on the wall. The tone is humorous and appeals to fish lovers.

This is an ad for Walgreens featuring Katlyn, a mother who explains that, due to her financial constraints, she needs to prioritize paying for gas and rent over buying vitamins for her toddler. A Walgreens community leader then mentions that when customers buy vitamins at Walgreens, a portion of the proceeds is donated to Vitamin Angels, a charity organization that helps deliver vitamins to families in need. The tone is positive and intended to appeal to a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for Volkswagen's GTI Mark V. Set in a warehouse, it features a German man in white scolding a car owner for his vehicle choice. The scene culminates with the man dropping a loaded shipping container on the car, crushing it, and revealing a new GTI Mark V. The tone is humorous and aims to appeal to a wide audience.

This animated ad for Click Safe shows a young child using the family computer to play an online game. Pop-up ads start appearing, cluttering the screen and eventually causing the computer to malfunction. The child calls their father for help, and he successfully closes the pop-up ads. The tone is educational and aimed at a general European audience.

This is an advertisement for McDonald's, showcasing lively scenes such as breakdancers, surfers, office workers racing in desk chairs, BMX riders, skateboarders, and people enjoying themselves overall. The tone is cheerful and inspiring, aiming at a diverse global audience.

This ad for Little Baby's Ice Cream features a woman's face, with mouths replacing her eyes, eerily smiling as a male narrator discusses the deliciousness and appeal of the ice cream. The tone is surreal and unsettling, aimed at ice cream enthusiasts.

This ad for the NRA shows a member speaking directly to the camera, criticizing Washington politicians for prioritizing efforts to take away the 2nd Amendment rather than protecting it, which could allow terrorists to pose a threat to America. The tone is politically charged and aimed at Americans who own guns.

This humorous video shows a man struggling to dispense mustard onto his hot dog. He then cleverly removes the lid from a carton of organic eggs and uses the egg holes to store his condiment bottles upside down. This way, he ensures condiments are always ready when squeezing.

This is a trailer for the folk horror movie The Witch, starring Anya Taylor-Joy. It showcases eerie scenes with the black goat, Black Phillip, as disturbing events unfold in a rural settlement. The tone is cinematic and haunting, appealing to horror film fans.

This trailer for Mercenaries 2 showcases the titular Mercenary being refused his payout at a bank. In response, he goes on a rampage, attacking everyone in sight with various weapons, including a vehicle equipped with armaments. The tone is energetic and aimed at gamers.

This is an advertisement for Azamara's Club Cruise line, showcasing scenes from the diverse destinations it visits, including golf courses, olive farms, boating trips, evening tours of fine-dining venues, and soccer matches. The tone is informative, aimed at potential tourists.

This ad for Tui beer shows three men sneaking into the brewery, guarded by attractive women in revealing uniforms. They manage to escape but are caught in the act after emerging from a river where female workers had been bathing. The tone is humorous and aimed at male beer drinkers.

This is a political lobbying ad for the Smarter Fuel Future campaign. It shows a cornfield with a refinery in the background, featuring a male narrator discussing the dangers of ethanol. Originally regarded as a cleaner, more sustainable alternative to oil, ethanol actually worsens air quality and doubles greenhouse gas emissions. The tone is politically charged, aimed at constituents.

This UK PSA warns against driving under the influence of drugs. It shows a group of friends driving at night, their eyes gradually enlarging as if bugged out, until they pass a police vehicle. The police notice them, and later stop the car because the woman in the back has eyes that reveal her intoxication. The tone is informative, warning UK drivers that drug driving carries penalties equal to those for drunk driving.

This is an advertisement for Iso Pure, shot in black-and-white. It features athletes from tennis, beach volleyball, MMA, and a disabled track runner, each performing their sport with background music. The tone is motivational and appeals to a wide audience.

This is a political campaign ad for Ted Cruz's presidential bid, styled as a Christmas-themed children's book advertisement. It shows Cruz in his living room with his wife and daughters, reading parody versions of Christmas children's books like "How Obamacare Stole Christmas," "Rudolph the Underemployed Reindeer," "A Wonderful Lie: A Very Merry Economy," and "The Senator Who Saved Christmas." The tone is playful and aimed at voters.

This vintage Nintendo ad showcases CGI versions of various Nintendo characters, such as Duck Hunt and Super Mario, proclaiming 'you cannot beat us' and challenging players to prove them wrong. The ad features footage of a boy playing Nintendo games on his TV. Its tone is both informative and surreal, appealing to 90s gamers.

This is an ad for Haynes Baked Beans featuring astronauts on the moon. They accidentally awaken a massive moon monster alien that effortlessly picks them off one by one, killing them all except for a single survivor hiding behind a rock. As the alien walks away, the astronaut's fart reveals his position. The tone is exciting and dramatic, with a touch of humor, appealing to a wide audience.

This brief ad for the mobile game Battle Camp showcases various creatures similar to Pokémon. These creatures begin as babies and evolve into larger, stronger, and more assertive forms. The ad concludes with the app's branding and where to download it. The tone is informative and aimed at young mobile gamers.

This is an advertisement for the National Basketball Association, or the NBA. It showcases dynamic still images of some of the most memorable moments in NBA history, accompanied by an uplifting piano instrumental soundtrack. The tone is inspiring and motivating, aimed at basketball enthusiasts.

This is a Bud Light advertisement. It shows office employees participating in a clothing drive, where each donation of clothing earns them a Bud Light. This Indian advertisement for Amul milk features empowered women, including a boxer, a motorcycle engineer, a dancer, and a badminton player, all working in a warehouse while drinking a glass of Amul milk. The tone is empowering and aims to appeal to a wide Indian audience.

This Coca-Cola Christmas ad showcases a convoy of brightly lit semi-trucks bearing the Coca-Cola brand, illuminating every building and structure they pass while a joyful Christmas song plays in the background. The tone is warm and festive, appealing to a wide audience during the holiday season.

This is an advertisement for Solidarité Internationale. It shows an artist skillfully creating an image on a canvas with water, then adding ink to bring the picture into focus. Meanwhile, a female narrator notes that water may be colorless, odorless, and shapeless, but it can also cause the deaths of millions, citing contaminated water. The tone is contemplative and aimed at journalists to encourage awareness and dissemination of the message.

This Australian PSA from the Queensland Government focuses on electrical safety. It shows a young girl playing in her large toy house, noting that she installed several safety switches for various electrical appliances. Her electrician father then addresses the viewers directly, encouraging them to consult with their electricians to ensure their homes are safe. The tone is educational and aimed at Queensland residents.

This is a French advertisement for Contrex mineral water. It mostly shows women riding pink pedal-powered machines. The scene ends with the man reappearing nude, with a sign over his crotch promoting the mineral water. The tone is tongue-in-cheek and targets a broad, health-conscious French audience.

This Regions Bank advertisement explains what home equity is and how homeowners can leverage it to finance significant expenses, such as college costs, home renovations, or starting a business. It also details how lenders can offer either a home equity loan or a line of credit. The tone remains informative and is aimed at homeowners.

This is an Indian advertisement for V-Guard's home battery inverters. It shows a man and woman on their wedding night, about to make love, when suddenly the power goes out. The man jumps towards the bed but lands crotch-first on the bedpost, injuring himself and becoming impotent. As a result, they now have to adopt children. The tone is humorous and aimed at Indians who frequently face blackouts.

This Irish PSA advocates for Civil Marriage equality for gay and lesbian individuals. It shows an Irishman going door-to-door, repeatedly asking for permission to marry his partner, Sinead. The video concludes with the question, "How would you feel if you had to ask 4 million people for permission to get married?" The tone is educational and aimed at Irish viewers.

This trailer for the action film London Has Fallen, starring Gerard Butler and Morgan Freeman, showcases a montage of scenes from the movie and outlines the basic plot: capturing and executing the sitting US President live on camera. The tone is dramatic, cinematic, and exciting, aimed at action movie enthusiasts.

This is an advertisement for Burger King Chicken Fries. It shows two roosters teasing a third about wanting to become a French fry. The third rooster responds confidently, affirming that he indeed wants to be a French fry. The tone is humorous, slightly surreal, and appeals to a wide audience.

This GQ video features Stephen and Dell Curry playing HORSE, with Stephen winning after missing just one shot, and it highlights their father-son bond. It has a fun, playful tone and is aimed at Stephen Curry and Golden State Warriors fans.

This is a Filipino McDonald's ad featuring a male and a female Filipino, shown in a split-screen. They sing about love, focusing on their affection for McDonald's, as they individually head to their nearest McDonald's. The tone is playful and heartfelt, appealing to a wide Filipino audience.

This ad promotes the Sega Genesis, showing Michael Jackson in a saloon setting where he dances and fights off bad guys. "Smooth Criminal" plays in the background as scenes from the Michael Jackson Sega Genesis game are overlaid. The tone is lively and informative, aimed at gamers.

This advertisement promotes Walkers Extra Crunchy Cheddar & Sour Cream crisps. It showcases well-known R&B singer Lionel Richie singing about sharing, as he appears in various scenes where people enjoy a bag of Walkers crisps. At one point, he attempts to grab a crisp from a man's hand, who then throws him out a glass window and walks away, only to reclaim his crisp before leaving. The ad's tone is humorous and aimed at a wide UK audience.

This is an advertisement for Manforce Condoms from India. It shows an attractive couple on a beach, gazing into each other's eyes and then embracing as they prepare to make love. The woman concludes, "Manforce Condoms: try something new." The tone is sensual and informative, aimed at sexually active Indians.

This Canadian promotional video for Dove's Campaign for Real Beauty shows a time-lapse of a woman being made up and groomed, then digitally altered to appear more attractive, before having her face projected onto the side of a billboard. The video emphasizes how societal beauty standards have changed. It has an informative and reflective tone, aimed at women and girls.

This Coca-Cola ad shows political pundits Bill Frist and James Carville sharing a Coke after a heated debate. They spend the day touring Washington, D.C. as friends, illustrating Coca-Cola's power to unite people, even those with opposing views. This is a brief advertisement for the online video series LEGO Exo Knights. It showcases scenes from the show, such as the Exo Knights fighting lava monsters controlled by the main villain, a pale-faced jester LEGO. The tone is informative and aimed at young boys.

This PSA from Greenpeace highlights the issue of palm oil production. It features Azizah, an Indonesian girl, standing in front of a deforested landscape. The video shows a montage of deforestation scenes and dead orangutans, then transitions to images of a Dove beauty product, linking Indonesian deforestation to Dove's use of palm oil. On-screen text warns that 98% of Indonesia's lowland forest could disappear by Azizah's 25th birthday. The tone remains serious and informative, encouraging viewers to pressure Dove to cease contributing to deforestation.

This is a political attack ad from Hillary Clinton's 2016 presidential campaign targeting Donald Trump. This is an Old Spice advertisement featuring the well-known spokesperson, a muscular, shirtless, dark-skinned man who speaks directly to the camera ("ladies') and promises rewards such as concert tickets or diamonds. This Vans advertisement, set against a white background, features an animated retelling of the company's history. These groups modified their shoes with their own iconic styles, which later became official designs. The ad also references Sean Penn's character in "Fast Times at Ridgemont High," which helped popularize Vans; it notes that, for legal reasons, the movie's title can't be mentioned, but viewers are expected to recognize it. The tone is informative, historical, and playful, aimed at Vans enthusiasts.

This UK PSA by the Embrace Life campaign from Sussex Safer Roads shows a man playing charades with his wife and daughter at home, pretending he's driving. The message highlights the importance of wearing a seatbelt in moving vehicles. The tone is cautionary and aimed at Sussex drivers.

This is an advertisement for the Indian phone provider Airtel. It shows young adults in their twenties on snowy mountain slopes near Mashobra, Shimla. This ad promotes the NES Classic Edition console, highlighting its new design and preloaded 30 classic NES games. This causes all LEGO characters and ice caps to be submerged in black tar, leaving only a lone Shell flag visible. The tone is serious and reflective, urging viewers to pressure LEGO to end its partnership with Shell.
