This is a trailer for WWE 2K17 showcasing MMA fighter Brock Lesnar as he approaches an underground fighting arena set in a rundown, post-apocalyptic cityscape. The tone is energetic and tense, appealing to WWE fans and Brock Lesnar enthusiasts alike.

This is a Russian Snickers advertisement showing a CGI squirrel looking in awe at a Snickers sign displaying all the nuts, while another squirrel walks by and faints from the sight. The tone is humorous, appealing to a wide Russian audience.

This is an ad for Treehouse featuring Ryan Carson, Co-Founder of Treehouse, who shares a testimonial from one of his students. The student is a new father and former electrician struggling to find work and support his family. After completing courses at Treehouse, he secured new employment, allowing him to cover his mortgage and provide for his family. The tone is encouraging and aims to inspire those seeking career change.

This is an informative PSA about heart disease from Our Health California. It includes infographics showing that $1 out of every $6 spent goes toward treating heart disease, highlighting that it is the leading cause of death in California. Additionally, it states that 6% of adults, or 1.9 million people, have been diagnosed. The tone is educational and aimed at Californians affected by heart conditions.

This is a UK advertisement for the food delivery app Just Eat. It shows a couple debating what to order, with the wife enthusiastically singing and dancing about her choice of chicken madras, while colorful male backup dancers join in as the scene shifts around their home. The tone is playful and aimed at UK viewers.

This Dutch ad for Central Beheer insurance shows a man attending an acupuncture session when suddenly the building catches fire. The acupuncturist leaves him behind and jumps out the window. Still pierced with needles, the man is then advised by emergency responders to jump onto the safety net below. The advert's tone is tense and stressful, aimed at Dutch viewers.

This Nike Football ad features a well-known Brazilian soccer star being pursued through his mansion by fellow players competing for his ball. As they cause chaos and destroy parts of his home, he manages to escape but is finally slide-tackled by his dog. The ad has an energetic, playful tone that appeals to international soccer fans.

This PSA addresses childhood obesity and features a mom and young boy sitting at a dining table. The mom arrives with a brown bag, pulls out items to prepare and inject heroin, but instead of doing so herself, she is shown about to inject her son. However, she pulls back and instead offers him a fast food burger. The PSA suggests that serving children junk food is akin to giving them drugs. The tone is serious and melodramatic, aimed at parents.

This is an ad for the fundraising campaign WillFerrellHatesCancer.com. It features fictional gamer "Will Pharell", played by actor Will Ferrell, who encourages viewers to donate to the fundraiser for a chance to win an all-expenses-paid trip to San Francisco to party with him. The tone is informative and aimed at gamers.

This [shampoo.ch](http://shampoo.ch) advertisement is set in a hair salon and features a muscular male window cleaner. As he cleans the salon's window from the outside, he reveals more of his physique, including his shirtless torso and bare legs, which appeal to women. The ad concludes with a close-up of his seemingly well-endowed crotch, later revealed to be a kitten tucked into his shorts. The tone is playful and tongue-in-cheek, targeting a female audience.

This is an ad for the GoPro Hero3, showing toddler Ava Osment skateboarding at Venice Beach while a GoPro mounted on the skateboard films her ride. The tone is playful and lighthearted, appealing to those looking for an action camera like a GoPro.

This is an ad for E-Trade, an online investment platform. It shows two men in a garage clapping along to La Cucaracha while a chimpanzee in an E-Trade shirt dances between them. The ad states that the scene cost $2 million, then prompts viewers to consider how they use their money, encouraging them to invest with E-Trade. The tone is humorous and appeals to people interested in investing.

This is a PSA from the League Against Cruel Sports about illegal fox hunting. It shows a mother having to abandon her baby in the crib and leave her home to fend off a pack of foxes threatening to attack. Eventually, the foxes catch up with the mother, leaving the baby alone. The tone is serious and somber, aimed at a general UK audience.

This is an advertisement for EA Sports' FIFA 15 video game. Set during Christmas, it shows Lionel Messi playing online against Eden Hazard, with both players' Christmas decorations and themed snacks, singing a rendition of 'Deck the Halls.' The tone is playful and festive, appealing to soccer fans and gamers alike.

This is a Spanish advertisement for Babybel. It shows two Babybel cheese discs calling themselves "Supercheese" (or "Superqueso" in Spanish) before being packed into a young boy's backpack for recess. The tone is cheerful and appeals to a wide Spanish-speaking audience.

This advertisement promotes tourism to South Africa. It shows a man on vacation with his wife, narrating as he explores South Africa's natural beauties, carefully experiencing them with his hands. At the end, it is revealed that he is blind when he pulls out a red striped walking stick. The tone is uplifting, aiming to attract tourists to South Africa.

This is an advertisement for Nescafé Creamy White powdered milk drink. It shows a South Asian couple preparing coffee and adding the Nescafé Creamy White powdered milk, while discussing its benefits and unique features, such as being made from real milk. The tone is informative and aimed at a wide audience.

This is a Chinese commercial for the Malaysian cookies Chips More! It shows three animated chocolate chip cookies dancing as they load a cannon with chocolate chips, which is about to be fired into a giant cookie in an oven. The tone is playful and aimed at a broad South Asian audience.

This is an April Fools' ad for YouTube showcasing Ben Relles, Director of Innovation, presenting SnoopaVision: a new feature that allows users to watch every video in 360 degrees with Snoop Dogg. Allegedly, Snoop was heavily involved in developing this feature from start to finish. The ad has a humorously dry tone and is aimed at a YouTube audience.

This ad for [TreesWork.org](http://TreesWork.org) by the Missouri Conservation Department features a talented young boy who appears wise beyond his years and even stronger than an adult, speaking to the camera about how spending time outdoors among trees helps him focus. He then invites viewers to visit the website to learn how kids can reach their potential. The tone is both informative and humorous, appealing to a wide audience.

This advertisement for Eveready Gold batteries features a young boy and his mother using various battery-powered devices, including a toy robot, a handheld camera, and a flashlight. A black cat is seen scurrying nearby, representing Eveready's black cat mascot. The tone is warm and appealing to a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for the mobile game Super Evolution. Clearly plagiarizing Pokémon, it features anime girls dressed as Pokémon, with scenes showcasing gameplay and mechanics. The tone is informative and alluring, aiming to attract both gamers and Pokémon fans.

This UK advertisement for Libero Pants Dance Collection features toddlers joyfully dancing to an energetic song, highlighting the diapers' snug fit, flexibility, softness, comfort, breathable material, and absorbency. The tone is wholesome, lighthearted, and aimed at parents with active toddlers.

This promo trailer for TBS' Separation Anxiety, hosted by Iliza Shlesinger, showcases couples separated to compete for money while confronting the uncertainties of the game's stakes. Pairs, whether romantic partners or friends, answer questions in different rooms, often leading to comedic, high-stress, and sometimes emotionally intense moments. The tone is humorous and informative, aiming at a broad adult audience.

This Australian drinking-and-driving PSA depicts a father drinking multiple beers before driving with his son and dog. They later ignore a stop sign and are T-boned by an oncoming petrol truck, which completely crushes their car. The tone remains serious and cautionary, aimed at Australian drivers.

This is an Indian advertisement for Yakult, a probiotic fermented milk drink. It shows an animated father and daughter, both shaped like Yakult bottles, discussing the benefits of Yakult's probiotics before their real-life counterparts arrive and drink them. The tone is friendly and informative, appealing to a wide Indian audience.

This is the opening of the PBS show Big Blue Marble. It starts with a shot of Earth from outer space, then zooms in to showcase different regions, their ecosystems, and ethnic groups. The song promotes intercultural learning and understanding. The tone is warm and educational, targeting young viewers.

This Sour Patch Kids ad shows a teenage boy sitting on a bus stop bench, playing on his handheld game. Suddenly, he gets pooped on from above. He moves to the other end of the bench, but the bird poops on him again. Looking up, he sees a giant Sour Patch Kid holding the pigeon responsible, which then comes down and says sorry. The ad is humorous and aimed at children.

This advertisement for Advanced Auto Parts is filmed in black and white within a mechanic's garage. It shows mechanics working on cars and performing repairs, with the ambient sounds of wrenches turning throughout the scene. The style is cinematic and aimed at car owners.

This is an advertisement for the Broadway musical Tuck Everlasting. It displays onscreen reviews from prominent publications such as The New York Times, accompanied by a male voiceover stating that the show is directed by the Tony Award-winning director of Aladdin and co-director of The Book of Mormon. The ad concludes with the show's title logo and mentions that previews start on March 31. The tone is informative and aimed at musical enthusiasts in New York.

This is an advertisement for the Google Play Store, showcasing an intricate analogue device that visualizes the narrator's claims about Google Play. It demonstrates features like purchasing a song on a computer and accessing it instantly on your phone, or playing a mobile game on a tablet, and starting a movie on a smartphone to finish on a TV or monitor. The tone is informative and innovative, appealing to a broad audience.

This is a PSA from the UK's Home Office about drinking responsibly. It shows a woman preparing for a night out, but she ends up ripping her blouse, vomiting, breaking her shoes' heels, smearing mascara, and spoiling her clothes. Onscreen text asks, 'You wouldn't start a night like this, so why end it that way?" The tone is informative and cautionary, aimed at adult drinkers.

This is a UK advertisement for the grape drink Ribena. Set in a park, it features woodland creatures such as hedgehogs, bunnies, red robins, and owls as they take over the park with rolling grapes, accompanied by a series of onscreen graphics that amplify the scene's chaos. The tone is playful and surreal, appealing to a wide UK audience.

This is a cinematic trailer for Plants vs. Zombies: Garden Warfare 2. Set to Queen's 'Don't Stop Me Now,' it showcases the Plants and Zombies as they clash across diverse landscapes, each armed with unique destructive weapons. The tone is playful and aimed at fans of the Plants vs. Zombies franchise.

This is an advertisement for Purple Feather, a service specializing in online content. It shows a blind homeless man asking for money in a busy city. A well-dressed woman walks past him and, instead of giving money, she alters the cardboard sign from "I'm blind, please help" to "It's a beautiful day, and I can't see it." The tone is uplifting and heartwarming, appealing to a wide audience, especially those seeking marketing services.

This is an advertisement for Google's Nexus One smartphone, highlighting its innovative features, including video streaming, photo capture, navigation, widgets, social media, and voice commands. The tone is informative and designed to appeal to a wide, tech-conscious audience.

This advertisement for Marks and Spencer showcases scenes of snacks, treats, and sweets, with on-screen text stating "100s of new ideas from The British Isles only at M&S." The tone remains informative and is aimed at a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for Under Armor's Curry Two sneakers. It shows Stephen Curry shooting free throws on a nearly dark basketball court, faintly lit by exploding flares, while a male narrator discusses how quickly basketball can lead to meaningful change. The tone is inspiring and motivating, appealing to basketball fans.

This Nike Basketball ad showcases LeBron James at different stages of his life, from childhood to adulthood, set against the same dark basketball court. As James narrates, he encourages viewers not to aspire to be like him, but to strive to surpass him. The tone is inspiring and aimed at basketball fans and players.

This is a public service announcement encouraging viewers to look both ways when crossing the street. It showcases animated young porcupines singing a remixed version of 'Stayin' Alive,' emphasizing the importance of taking precautions, looking both ways, and crossing only when safe, to "stay alive." The tone is educational and aimed at a younger audience.

This advertisement for Bonds, an undergarment company, presents a playful and informative remix of "The Twelve Days of Christmas." It shows people of all ages, from toddlers to adults, in their underwear, replacing the traditional items mentioned in the carol. The tone is light-hearted and aimed at a wide Australian audience.

This is a PSA from AT&T's It Can Wait Campaign. It shows four girls in a car performing an elaborate dance and lip-syncing to a song. When the driver responds to a notification on her phone, she immediately crashes the car. The actress driving then speaks directly to the camera, emphasizing that no text, post, or video is worth risking a life, and that it should be saved for later. The tone is serious and informative, targeting drivers.

This Japanese ad for Calbee potato chips depicts a heartbreak-stricken Japanese boy whose dog, attempting to cheer him up, becomes bipedal and starts dancing. Eventually, the boy catches the girl's attention and feels happy, but this makes the dog jealous. The tone is humorous with a slightly unsettling edge, aiming at a wide Japanese audience.

This is a Snickers ad set at a house party, featuring two male friends, including Brad, played by a disgruntled Joe Pesci. Brad is trying to flirt with two young women when he gets angry at them. His friend then takes him aside, offers him a Snickers, and after eating it, Brad returns to his usual self. They go back to the girls and discover that Stacy has transformed into insult comic Don Rickles. The ad has a humorous tone and appeals to a broad audience.

This is a Japanese cinematic trailer for the fighting game Pokken Tournament. It showcases various Pokémon engaging in one-on-one battles, including Lucario, Pikachu, Suicune, and Machamp. The tone is lively and entertaining, appealing to Pokémon fans and fighting game enthusiasts alike.

This is an advertisement for Manforce Strawberry Flavored Condoms. It shows a woman striking various provocative and suggestive poses in different settings, such as on a bed, in her bathtub, or poolside, always surrounded by strawberries, including taking a bath filled with strawberries. The tone is sexy, aimed at sexually active individuals wanting to sweeten their sex life.

This ad for Grey Poupon Dijon Mustard features a wealthy man in a vintage Rolls-Royce limousine enjoying a fine meal in the backseat. He applies a dollop of Grey Poupon Dijon Mustard directly from a jar stored in a seat compartment. The car stops, and a similar-looking vehicle pulls up beside him, with a distinguished gentleman also in the backseat. The other man asks if he has any Grey Poupon, to which the first man replies, "Of course," and then drives away without sharing. The tone is humorous and appeals to a wide audience.

This WWE 2K16 game trailer features Arnold Schwarzenegger reprising his role as the Terminator in a recreated scene from the first Terminator film. The scene shows Arnold's character entering naked and attacking three bikers, now replaced by WWE Superstars and divas as patrons. The Terminator singles out Dean Ambrose, approaches him, and demands his clothes and motorcycle. The tone is cinematic and nostalgic, appealing to both WWE and Terminator fans.

This is a State Farm commercial featuring two male friends hanging out in Dave's living room when a baseball suddenly crashes through the window. Unfazed, Dave sings loudly, "like a good neighbor, State Farm is there," which instantly teleports his State Farm agent into the apartment. The friends then sing the jingle themselves to see what else can be teleported in, such as a sandwich, a girl from another apartment, or a hot tub. The overall tone is lighthearted and humorous, appealing to those seeking a dependable insurance provider.

This Old Spice commercial promotes its men's deodorant and body wash. It shows the well-known Old Spice spokesperson speaking to the audience, referring to them as 'ladies,' while his background shifts between different settings. The tone is humorous and surreal, primarily aimed at men.

This Australian ad for Nestlé's Ice Cream Drumsticks is set at a public pool. It shows bathers arriving and moving in synchronized actions, such as laying down towels, applying sunscreen to the person in front, or all the men glancing at an attractive girl in a bikini as she walks by. The women respond by sitting up to smack them, breaking the pattern when one young man starts eating a Drumstick from the bottom instead of the top. This catches everyone's attention and prompts others to mimic him. The ad is humorous and aimed at a wide audience.

This UK ad by the Young Director Awards shows a mom driving with her young daughter, who is stopped by a police officer. After greeting the girl, the officer is told by the girl that the driver isn't her mother, holding up a notepad with "help" scribbled in crayon. The officer then asks the woman to step out of the car, while the girl stares directly into the camera, a mischievous grin on her face. The tone shifts from cinematic and serious to humorous, aiming to attract young filmmakers and encourage them to be considered for awards.

This is a fictional advertisement for the Mount Saint LeRoux Cabernet Sauvignon 2002, created by the internet comedy channel College Humor. Styled like a standard beer commercial and set in a pool party, it shows college frat party attendees drinking the wine as if it were beer. The tone is humorous and aimed at an online audience.

This promotional video for Chanel, titled Rouge Allure, draws inspiration from Erwin Blumenfeld's photographic style. It showcases a montage of a woman's face arranged similarly to the famous Jean Patchett Vogue cover. The overall tone is artistic and cinematic, aiming to appeal to Chanel enthusiasts.

This Thai Paddle Pop Atlantos advertisement depicts children buying the ice cream popsicles, then transforming into the superpowered mascot characters shown on the packaging, and finally scenes from the animated promotional films. The tone is playful and informative, targeting Thai youth.

This is an Indian campaign for BMW Financial Services. It showcases 10 families enjoying surprising test drives, where periodically, flash mobs like ballerinas, a symphony orchestra, or little girls throwing petals appear in front of them. The experience culminates on a red carpet, where they are surprised by an Indian celebrity. The tone is wholesome and exciting, targeting a wide Indian audience.

This ad promotes Quixels, The Cubes That Join With Water. It showcases Cartoon Network mascots from the Check-It era as they create and interact with their Quixels sets, demonstrating how to make Quixels art simply by spraying water. The tone is informative and aimed at young Cartoon Network viewers.

This is an infomercial for the Smart Mop, starring infomercial personality Anthony Sullivan. He demonstrates the Smart Mop's features, such as its ability to be wrung out by twisting the handles, eliminating the need to bend over, and its capacity to easily pick up stubborn residue without prior vacuuming or sweeping. The tone is informative and appeals to a wide audience.

This UK anti-domestic abuse PSA from the Home Office depicts a teen couple watching TV in the girl's bedroom. The boyfriend initially pressures his girlfriend for sex, which she refuses, but his insistence grows more forceful. He becomes physically aggressive and verbally berates her. A different version of the boy, looking at the scene as if in an out-of-body experience, repeatedly shouts at himself to stop, but he does not. The tone is serious and aimed at a broad UK audience.

This is a Thai advertisement for Ranger Energy Drink. It depicts people running through the streets while a bull charges at them, with a woman falling to the ground and about to be gored. A man observes this scene, drinks from a Ranger can, then bravely jumps in to face the bull, transforming into a tiger. The tone is dramatic and aimed at a wide Thai audience.

This is a PSA for Greenpeace New Zealand. It shows a woman coming home from work and pouring herself a glass of Fonterra milk. As she drinks, she chokes on hair in the milk, which later turns out to belong to orangutans. The ad then shows scenes of deforestation, with onscreen text explaining that Fonterra's use of palm kernel contributes to rainforest destruction. The tone begins lighthearted but shifts to serious and informative, targeting New Zealanders.

This Indian advertisement for TBZ footwear depicts a traditional Indian wedding. The groom searches for his shoes but cannot find them near his bride's heels. After asking the guests, his bride lifts her gown to show she has been wearing the shoes all along, prompting laughter from everyone. The tone is playful and aimed at a wide Indian audience.

This is a political lobbying ad from the Coalition for Medicare Choices. It shows seniors speaking directly to the camera, encouraging viewers to vote to preserve Medicare Advantage and oppose its repeal. The tone is political and informative, targeting American voters, particularly seniors enrolled in Medicare.

This is a safety PSA from TAC Safety in Victoria, Australia. It shows two drivers, a car driver and a motorcycle rider, sharing the same lane. The car driver criticizes motorcycle riders, calling them a nuisance. When the perspective shifts to the motorcycle rider, cautious and alert, the car suddenly swerves and hits him, knocking him to the ground. The tone is serious and educational, aimed at motorists in Victoria.

This advertisement promotes Ambi Pur, a type of Indian Febreeze. It features Indian personality Boman as he visits a woman's home to demonstrate Ambi Pur's odor elimination. She prepares Tadka, a traditional but pungent Indian dish, allowing its scent to fill the house. Then Ambi Pur is used to mask the smell, tested by having her husband and friend, blindfolded, enter and sit in front of the Tadka without noticing the scent. The tone is informative and aimed at a broad Indian audience.

This is a trailer for the Christian film Miracles from Heaven. It shows a young girl with a brain tumor who, after falling from a 30-foot tree branch, was not paralyzed by the impact. Remarkably, the fall and the impact seem to have healed her brain tumor. The tone is inspirational and faith-based, aimed at Christian audiences.

This vintage Southwest Airlines ad shows an orange-clad woman standing on an airport runway, speaking to the viewer. She asks if they recall a time before Southwest and its amenities, such as first-class legroom, free cocktails, quick service to the US Southwest, and a reliable flight schedule, while a plane flies overhead. The tone is nostalgic and informative, aimed at Southwest travelers.

This ad for Wonderful Pistachios features K-Pop star PSY, dressed in a bright green suit, performing a remix of his famous song "Gangnam Style." The new lyrics subtly reference cracking pistachios, while dancers in pistachio-colored costumes dance alongside him.

This Indian ad for Candyman's Jellicious is set at the fictional Candyman Scout Camp. It shows scouts in a line eating Jellicious candy, making them wiggle and dance like jelly, including the scoutmaster at the end. The tone is humorous and lighthearted, aimed at a young Indian audience.

This campaign ad for Bernie Sanders' 2016 presidential run includes footage of FDR signing the Glass-Steagall Act, which separated big banks and prevented central banks from dominating the US financial system. This law was repealed in the late 90s, leading to banks becoming "too big to fail" and allowing direct funding of politicians, which fostered bias. Bernie Sanders faces criticism for wanting to break up big banks, though his campaign is entirely funded by ordinary American donors. The tone aims to inform and appeals to voters.

This is an advertisement for Verizon's ClickAway repair service. It shows a toddler carelessly handling an unprotected iPhone, with onscreen text stating that although ClickAway cannot stop a baby from grabbing their phone, it can repair or replace it if that happens, offering the lowest repair prices available. The tone is informative and aimed at phone owners.

This is an advertisement for Heineken, created in collaboration with the film Skyfall. It showcases Daniel Craig's James Bond as he encounters an unseemly man mistaken for Bond by villains. The villains chase them onto a train, passing luxurious cars, and end with Bond giving the man a Heineken and escaping by parachuting over a bridge. The tone is cinematic and appeals to adults who enjoy drinking and James Bond fans.

This Skittles ad shows teen boys eating Skittles and then being whisked away by a rainbow. The rainbow often takes them to positive places, such as a boy being moved from a dull pool to a scene of cheering fans, or a cheerleader mascot ending up at a campground, happily playing guitar with campers. The ad is humorous and aimed at a wide teenage audience.

This ad for Nolan's Cheddar depicts a rat caught in a snapping mousetrap. However, the rat isn't actually dead; instead, it uses the trap's metal rod as a makeshift exercise bar, set to 'Eye of the Tiger'. The tone is humorous and appeals to a wide audience.

This ad for Mott's Snack & Go applesauce shows a mom after a walk with other moms, noticing their fancy kids' lunches. She talks to the camera about how she spends a lot of time researching and preparing visually appealing, elaborate lunches for her children. However, she soon discovers that her kids prefer the Mott's Snack & Go pouches, as they haven't eaten her creations. The tone is lighthearted and whimsical, aimed at parents of young children.

This Thai ad for Chiclets Gum shows a girl in a park rowing a boat, with a young man in front who's eagerly chewing Chiclets Gum. To turn his chewing into something useful, the girl dunks his head underwater, using his vibrating head like a human boat propeller. The ad is humorous and aims to appeal to a wide Thai audience.

This is an advertisement for Doritos Cool Ranch. It shows a trout leaping out of a lake and grabbing a nearby fisherman's open bag of Cool Ranch Doritos, then hopping back into the water. The tone is humorous and playful, appealing to a wide audience, especially Doritos enthusiasts.

This is an ad for Clash of Clans. It shows a cinematic cutscene with several characters resembling Mr. T, riding hogs and gathering at another's call to join a battle. The tone is playful and humorous, aimed at mobile gamers.

This is an advertisement for the Despicable Me Minion Rush mobile app. It highlights the gameplay and mechanics of the mobile game, featuring the famous Minions, along with new game modes and additional playable missions. The tone is informative and aimed at young mobile gamers and fans of Despicable Me.

This is an advertisement for Eastern Michigan University. It features a montage of campus classrooms, labs, and even a recording booth, while a male narrator highlights EMU's experiential learning, both inside and outside the classroom, and emphasizes genuine partnerships between undergraduates and faculty. The tone is informative and aimed at prospective undergraduate students in the Midwest.

This is an advertisement for Nescafé Classic coffee, featuring an Indian R&B artist singing about Nescafé in a recording studio. The montage shows everyday Indian people going about their day, brewing or drinking Nescafé. The tone is cinematic and aimed at Indian coffee enthusiasts.

This advertisement for [WireFly.com](http://WireFly.com), an online store selling smartphones, features a female narrator explaining what an Android phone is, its manufacturer, its popularity, its features and uses, and how it compares to an iPhone. The tone is educational and aimed at early smartphone adopters.

This advertisement for Diamond Crystal salt features Scott Foefod, Principal Scientist of the Research and Development department, explaining the difference between soft water—rainwater—and hard water, which is water that has been absorbed by the soil and transported to streams or rivers. The tone is informative and intended for a general audience.

This is a MasterCard ad featuring American Football player Peyton Manning. In one of his "Priceless Pep Talks" segments, he humorously tells male viewers that, unless they are under 23 or a professional football player, their chances of losing the gut and gaining abs are slim to none. Therefore, it might be better for them to just buy larger shirts. The tone is light-hearted and aimed at football fans.

This UK advertisement for Tango Orange soft drink is shot like a sports replay highlight reel. It shows a young man outside a shop drinking from a can of Tango Orange. Suddenly, a large orange Tango man appears, slaps the young man's cheeks, and then flees. The tone is humorous, targeting a UK audience.

This promotional video for [wayfair.com](http://wayfair.com) features HGTV personality Peyton Lambton teaching viewers how to create a rustic outdoor dinner setup for indoor use. She highlights the available items on Wayfair, including their prices. The tone is informative and aimed at homemakers and even hosts.

This is an advertisement for Publix featuring a strawberry farmer from Plant City, Florida. He discusses his winter strawberry harvest, highlighting how the region's excellent weather benefits his crops. The video shows his farm and town, while he explains that the strawberries are transported to Publix supermarkets nationwide on the same day they are picked, ensuring freshness.

This is an advertisement for Littlest Pet Shop by Hasbro. It highlights the main Pets, with over 150 characters to collect, as shown in the ad. Some Pets have shimmering or glowing features, motivating viewers to collect all 150. The tone is cheerful and informative, aimed at girls.

This advertisement promotes the Marks and Spencer summer clothing collection. It showcases female models on a pier boardwalk, dancing and posing to display their summer attire from Marks and Spencer. The tone is lively and informative, aimed at fashion-conscious women.

This is an advertisement for Zazoo condoms. It shows a father at a grocery store with his misbehaving son, who throws a huge tantrum when his father returns a bag of candy the son wanted, leading to chaos in the store. The ad concludes with the message "use condoms." The tone is slightly awkward yet informative, aimed at sexually active individuals.

This is an ad for SmartBeep's beeper service. It shows a young woman getting into her date's car on the front passenger side. After her date closes her door and she thinks she's alone, she accidentally lets out a loud fart. When her date comes in, he introduces his friends Greg and Janice, who were sitting in the back seat, and they all witness her awkward moment. The tone is humorous and appeals to a wide audience interested in a beeper service.

This is an advertisement for Ecot, an accredited online K-12 school. It showcases young Xavier McDaniel giving an interview-style testimonial about his family's jazz band, where he plays the drums. He explains that, thanks to Ecot, he can better balance his education with his passion for music than in a traditional school setting. The tone is informative and aimed at audiences interested in homeschooling or online education.

This is an advertisement for the Tripit mobile app. It shows people sharing their not-so-great travel experiences, like long security lines or a lengthy walk to the gate, only to miss their flight or find out it was delayed. The ad highlights how Tripit's travel organization features can make such situations easier. The tone is informative and targets travelers.

This is a trailer for the Disney/Pixar video game Cars 2. It showcases gameplay scenes and mechanics, such as a battle royale with weapon attachments like in Twisted Metal, intercut with cinematics featuring the film's characters. The tone is informative, targeting young gamers and fans of the movie alike.

This is an advertisement for The Camera Store. It shows cameramen in a field "shooting" their cameras, with rapid shutter sounds resembling gunfire. The scene mimics a war shootout, with the cameras as the guns and the film stock as the bullet magazines to be reloaded. The tone is humorous and aimed at photographers and videographers.

This is an advertisement for Homebase, a furniture store in the UK. It shows a family transforming their living room by effortlessly peeling off wallpaper to reveal new patterns underneath. They scroll through different floorboards and tiles to update the flooring, pull curtains to change wall colors, or flip the sofa to give it a new look. The tone is cheerful and informative, aimed at UK homeowners.

This vintage Indian DSTV ad depicts a meeting between two families to arrange a marriage. It humorously shows a young bride switching between different versions of her potential groom, as if changing TV channels, using a remote. These versions include the original heavyset dweeb, a greaser biker, a Bruce Lee-like martial artist, a John Travolta-style disco dancer, a James Bond-type spy, and an Elvis impersonator. The ad's tone is light-hearted and aims at a wide Indian audience.

This ad for Big Red cinnamon gum shows couples, such as a pair posing for a sculpture, a couple camping, or a young school band player, embracing and kissing longer because of Big Red's long-lasting fresh breath, with the jingle playing in the background. The tone is informative and appeals to a wide audience.

This is a PSA from Smog Spotter showing an animated yellow car. Its black exhaust fumes fill the top half of the screen with smog, while on-screen text urges viewers to "Keep Nevada's Air Healthy" and "Report Smoking Vehicles." The tone is informative and directed at Nevada residents.

This is a vintage black-and-white advertisement for Dorothy Gray cleansing cream. It features a female narrator who compares Dorothy Gray's cleansing products with competitors, highlighting their unhealthy ingredients and radioactivity, as demonstrated by an examiner using a Geiger counter. In contrast, Dorothy Gray's soaps and facial cream are shown to be free of radioactivity and effective at removing dirt and grime from pores. The tone is informative and aimed at women.

This ad for Fan Duel features a disgruntled American Football coach criticizing his team and its key players, then walking out on the squad to join a new team for the upcoming week, taking only his favorite player with him. It humorously illustrates Fan Duel's ability to play in one-week football leagues for cash prizes. The tone is lighthearted and aimed at fantasy football gamblers.

This advertisement promotes the mobile game Clash of Kings. It showcases cinematic scenes set in a medieval world, along with gameplay elements such as empire-building, army assembly, and alliance forging. The tone is informative and aimed at young mobile gamers.

This is an advertisement for Thomas Land at Drayton Manor Theme Park. It shows two young siblings, a boy and a girl, watching Thomas the Tank Engine and wishing that Thomas and his world were real so they could experience it firsthand. The scene then shifts to the Thomas Land theme park within Drayton Manor, showcasing the rides and attractions. The tone is informative and aimed at a young UK audience who love Thomas the Tank Engine.

This is an advertisement for the BlackBerry 10 smartphone. It shows scenes of BlackBerry developers creating innovative hardware and software, highlighting features like the QNX Operating System, which is claimed to be so fast and reliable that NASA uses it for space missions. The tone is cinematic and informative, aimed at smartphone enthusiasts.

This is a PSA from the National Weather Service and the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. It shows a car attempting to cross a flooded section of road with active currents. Onscreen text warns that "it takes just 12 inches of flowing water to carry off a small car; 18 to 24 inches for larger vehicles," ending with the slogan "Turn Around, Don't Drown." The tone remains serious and aimed at informing a general American audience.

This is an advertisement for Net-A-Porter. It shows a blonde model dancing to music in a luxurious hotel room, changing outfits and footwear throughout. The ad frequently features close-ups of her feet, highlighting different shoes and heels suitable for the season. The overall tone is playful and aimed at women.

This ad promotes the Puma Evo Power 1.2 soccer cleat by showcasing two renowned international soccer players. They compete to see who can score the most free kicks as obstacles are progressively added between them and the goal. Each kick gets more spectacular and seems to defy physics, all while they wear their Evo Power 1.2s. The tone is lively and thrilling, aimed at soccer fans.

This vintage animated ad for Fritos corn chips features the Frito mascot, the Frito Bandito, who encourages viewers to sing along about the chips, making them feel like honorary Frito Banditos. The tone is fun and appeals to a wide younger audience.

This ad for the Mercedes-Benz E-Class features a blonde woman attempting to order a burger, fries, and a milkshake from a librarian. When she's informed she's in a library, she doesn't leave but instead repeats her order quietly, the ad culminating with the on-screen phrase "beauty is nothing without brains." The ad has a humorous tone and appeals to a wide audience.

This Adidas ad shows two Hispanic boys from the slums putting together their dream team of famous soccer players, calling out their roster as the real-life players gather around them, leading to a lively match. The tone is playful and aimed at international soccer fans, particularly those watching the World Cup.

This is a brief advertisement for American Marriage Ministries. It asks, "Who will perform your wedding?" and then lists possible candidates such as "your mom? Your brother? Your best friend?" before concluding with "Your wedding. Your choice." The tone is informative, aimed at individuals who want to officiate their loved ones' weddings.

This ad showcases Axe Dark Temptation body spray, featuring a skinny young man. He sprays the product on himself and transforms into a happy, chocolate-human figure. Throughout his day in town, women are drawn to him, grabbing or biting his chocolatey limbs. The tone is playful and appeals to a young male audience.

This anti-bullying ad is part of The Fight Against Bullying campaign for Dr. Drew's Life Changers segment. It shows Dr. Drew, a daytime talk show host, interviewing a young boy about his bullying experiences, which led to him being forced out of school. The segment concludes with Dr. Drew urging viewers to intervene and combat such violence. The tone is serious and aimed at a wide audience.

This vintage ad for Dr. Pepper features a musical performance by the main actor, who sings about the different varieties of Dr. Pepper available as he moves between water containers in various US locations, indicated by backgrounds such as the St. Louis Arch, Manhattan skyscrapers, and the Golden Gate Bridge. The tone is lighthearted and appeals to a wide audience.

This vintage ad showcases the Polaroid Swinger instant camera, featuring young adults in their twenties having a lively day at the beach. They are captured taking pictures with their Polaroid Swinger cameras, advertised at an affordable $19.95. The tone is lively and informative, appealing to a wide audience.

This Walmart ad is set at a children's birthday party, where a father dons a clown costume to surprise the kids while the mom tells her friend how affordable the decorations, food, and aforementioned clown costume were. However, the father accidentally jumps on a unicorn figurine, stabbing himself and letting out a loud howl that scares the children. They scream and run away in fear. The ad is humorous and aims to appeal to a wide audience.

This advertisement promotes the PS4 online multiplayer game Destiny. It begins with a lively guitar jingle celebrating the joy of sharing, showing gameplay clips from Destiny matches. The scene then zooms out to display the PS4 interface, highlighting the various Destiny-related posts users can share through the console's new sharing features. The tone is informative and aimed at gamers, particularly PlayStation fans and FPS online game enthusiasts like Destiny players.

This Guinness beer advertisement shows a side profile of a nude female figure rocking gently, with a Guinness bottle balanced on her arched lower back. Occasionally, a hand appears to take a drink from the bottle, positioned behind, in front of, or underneath the woman, subtly suggesting she is engaging sexually with three men simultaneously. The tone is tongue-in-cheek, aimed at mature beer enthusiasts.

This vintage ad for Keep America Beautiful depicts a Native American in traditional clothing paddling a canoe across a polluted river, where factory waste is visible. The scene then shows the figure reaching the shore and witnessing people littering by throwing garbage out of their cars. The overall tone is serious and informative, emphasizing the importance of not littering to a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for the Crusha drink, showing images of cats energetically playing music and literally praising Crusha, highlighting how well it pairs with milk and showcasing the various flavors. The tone is surreal, informative, and humorous, and appeals to a wide audience.

This ad promotes the ASUS Zenfone Max smartphone through a humorous scenario. It shows a speed rapper talking rapidly on his phone in a busy grocery market because his battery is low, forcing him to speed up his speech to finish the call. The ad concludes with a male narrator stating that the ASUS Zenfone Max can last 38 days on a single charge, solving the problem depicted earlier. The tone is lighthearted and appeals to users who want a phone with longer battery life.

This is a Thai ad for Chiclets gum, showing a young man voraciously chewing. His heavy-set mother, noticing his restless head movements, cleverly uses a wide rubber belt behind his head and over her belly, turning him into a makeshift vibrating belt machine. The tone is humorous and aimed at a Thai audience.

This is an advertisement for the Presidential Car Wash, featuring an Indian family rapping, albeit poorly, about their services. Each family member is dressed as a different founding father or colonial figure, highlighting the various services and prices offered. Although the Car Wash is a legitimate business, the commercial aims to parody typical low-effort, low-quality local ads. Its tone is humorous and informative, targeting the general San Fernando Valley community.

This Doritos advertisement is set during an ultrasound session. It shows a new father eating Doritos while his wife is being scanned. The unborn baby is depicted reaching for a Doritos chip and adjusting its position each time the father waves it around. An annoyed wife snatches the chip and throws it toward her legs, prompting the unborn baby to chase after it, seemingly forcing itself to be born to claim the discarded Dorito. The humor is broad and designed to appeal to a wide audience.

This is a vintage Dr. Pepper ad showing young beachgoers partying and drinking only Dr. Pepper, with a catchy jingle playing in the background that promotes Dr. Pepper's unique taste and urges viewers to "taste the Dr. Pepper difference." The tone is friendly, upbeat, and aimed at a wide audience.

This is a commercial for Love's Baby Soft. It shows an adult woman, innocently looking into the camera, slowly licking a lollipop. The narrator explains that people can't resist babies, which is why Love created Baby Soft, which is said to have the scent of a cuddly, clean baby... who has grown up to be sexy (hence the woman). The tone is playful and appeals to a wide audience.

This Japanese ad for Morinaga's Chocoball features live-action heads overlaid onto animated chocolate ball-chick hybrids. These characters follow a toucan-shaped figure across a playground while singing "chucoru boru." The advertisement has a surreal tone and appeals to a wide Japanese audience.

This Pepsi advertisement shows a young girl approaching a bar counter and asking for a Pepsi. Instead of serving her a Pepsi, the bartender pours a drink from a nozzle labeled "Coke," which is styled in Coca-Cola's colors. When the girl takes a sip, she gains the bartender's attention by speaking in the same cadence, tone, and pitch as Don Vito Corleone. She points out the mistake calmly yet menacingly and insists on a Pepsi, causing fear to permeate among other patrons. The ad has a humorous tone and appeals to a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for Exposed Skincare, showcasing its product line, including the Facial Cleanser, Clearing Tonic, Clear Pre Serum, and Acne Treatment Serum. These products are depicted while a female narrator explains their benefits and intended uses. The tone is informative and aimed at individuals with acne.

This is an Indian advertisement for Tanishq's Divyam Festive Heritage Collection. It shows a young woman narrating her home life with her parents as they get ready for Diwali. The story ends with the whole family dressed in traditional clothing, and the young woman wearing the necklace her father gifted her. The tone is heartwarming and appeals to a wide Indian audience.

This is an advert for the TP-Link Archer C3200 Wi-Fi router. Set against a black background, it shows the Archer router spinning, emphasizing its features, while onscreen text describes its advanced capabilities, such as faster Wi-Fi speeds and extended range, ideal for high-bandwidth devices. The tone is informative and aimed at users who rely on high-speed Wi-Fi.

This anti-marijuana PSA by the Partnership for a Drug-Free America is set in school halls. It shows two friends, one offering marijuana and the other hesitant to try. The camera then reveals that this scene is fictional, presented to a group of younger children with animated 80s Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles asking what the hesitant boy should do. When called a chicken, the boy calls the other a turkey and walks away. The tone is informative and aimed at school-aged children.

This is a road safety PSA from the Naval Safety Center highlighting the importance of seatbelt use. It shows a group of young men who fatally crash into a tree beside a country road. All but one of the passengers' spirits rose to heaven; the lone survivor was the passenger wearing a seatbelt. The message is serious and cautionary, intended for a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for Ultraman Bubblegum. It shows a young boy boarding a school bus, only to discover that the other passengers are wearing Ultraman masks and that the bus driver is the real Ultraman. The driver offers the boy a pack of Ultraman Bubblegum that includes temporary sticker tattoos. The tone is cheerful and aimed at young viewers, particularly Ultraman fans.

This is an advertisement for Zazoo condoms. It shows a father and an unruly child who has a temper tantrum, causing chaos in the store after the father puts back an item the boy wanted to add to the grocery cart. The message is "use condoms" to prevent unwanted children when not prepared for parenthood. The tone is informative and cautionary, aimed at sexually active individuals.

This is a political attack ad against Mitt Romney, endorsed by Barack Obama's presidential campaign. It shows scenes of Romney promising a stronger economy, with on-screen graphics and a male narrator explaining that during his tenure as governor of Massachusetts, the state lost 40,000 manufacturing jobs, ranking it near the bottom nationally in job creation. The tone is politically provocative and aims to influence voters.

This anti-smoking ad from the US Department of Health and Human Services and the CDC includes a testimonial from a former smoker. It shows her wearing a nasal cannula delivering constant oxygen because of her COPD, emphysema, chronic bronchitis, and pneumonia. She describes having to always carry oxygen tanks due to her smoking history. The tone is cautionary and informative, aimed at smokers and potential smokers.

This vintage ad showcases Super Mario Bros., Super Mario 2, and Super Mario 3 for Nintendo. It depicts many young people dressed in blue, white, and red who repeatedly chant "Mario" while the camera pulls back to reveal that they form a giant Mario face seen from outer space. The tone is playful and appeals to Super Mario fans.

This is a PSA for 1-800-END-ABUSE addressing domestic violence. It shows a young boy sitting on a staircase, having to see and hear his mother being physically and verbally abused by his father. The tone is serious and aimed at victims of domestic abuse.

This advertisement promotes Almarai milk and depicts a traditional Muslim family having breakfast. The matriarch pours milk into her children's cups or cereal bowls as they enjoy their meal. The father attempts to dunk a biscuit into a glass of milk but fails. The overall tone is cheerful and appeals to a wide Arabic audience.

This is an advertisement for the NFL's fantasy football website, nfl.com/fantasy. It shows a New York Giants player asking his teammate for advice on who to start on his fantasy team, which sparks a playful argument over selecting Julio Jones instead of his teammate. The tone is humorous and informative, aimed at both football fans and fantasy football players.

This advertisement promotes Amity University, a higher education institution in India. It showcases a montage of the diverse sports programs available on campus, including tennis, archery, wrestling, boxing, and gymnastics, and highlights its partnership with the official Indian Olympic Association. The tone is informative and aimed at attracting prospective Indian student-athletes.

This ad for Iron Sport Gym in Glenolden, PA, shows the owner giving a tour to a stereotypically nerdy man who becomes increasingly mopey at each workout station, complaining with terms like "alarm" or "planet" while mocking chain gyms like Planet Fitness and their approach. The tone is informative yet spiteful and mean-spirited, aimed at potential gym members.

This Snickers ad is set in ancient China, featuring wuxia ninjas climbing building walls while 'Cheung,' played by Robert Atkinson as Mr. Bean, awkwardly follows them. After falling through a roof during a clumsy jump, the ninjas give Mr. Bean a Snickers, claiming he's not himself when hungry. Upon eating a bite, Cheung reverts to his normal self and quickly escapes from approaching guards. The ad has a humorous tone and appeals to a wide audience.

This flu PSA by the Government of South Australia, available at [www.flu.sa.gov.au](http://www.flu.sa.gov.au), shows extreme slow-motion footage of people mid-sneeze set to operatic music. It emphasizes the fluid spread from mouths and noses and encourages South Australians to reduce influenza transmission by getting a flu shot. The tone is informative and specifically targets residents of South Australia.

This anti-bigotry PSA features a diverse group of children speaking directly to the camera. They serve as stand-ins for parents, encouraging them to set a positive example by avoiding exposure to bigotry and refraining from judging others based on race, skin color, orientation, religion, or ethnicity. Instead, the message promotes teaching tolerance and acceptance. The tone is informative and specifically aimed at parents.

This is an advertisement for Shortline Dental featuring internet sensation Sweet Brown, known as the "ain't nobody got time for that" lady. She describes a situation in which she experienced a severe toothache after biting into a cold ice pop, which resolved after visiting the Shortline Dental offices. The tone is both informative and humorous, aiming at residents of Tulsa, Oklahoma.

This is a political attack ad from President Barack Obama's 2012 campaign targeting Republican candidate Mitt Romney. The ad highlights Romney's income and his comparatively low tax payments compared to those of the average middle-class American. It also criticizes his plan to raise taxes on ordinary Americans while lowering them for the wealthy. The tone is partisan and aimed at influencing voters.

This Nike Football ad depicts Liverpool, England, transforming its cityscape to celebrate Spanish culture and colors. It shows roadside shops selling paella pans, flamenco and Spanish language classes, and Spanish flags hanging outside apartment windows, all sparked by Liverpool FC signing Spanish player Fernando Torres, also called "El Niño." The ad has a humorous tone and appeals to soccer fans.

This Irish PSA by the Road Safety Authority features a montage of an elderly woman reflecting on different moments of her life. Her expressions become increasingly somber as the story unfolds, culminating in the tragic loss of her young daughter, who was killed when she briefly looked away from the road to attend to her fussing child. The PSA emphasizes the importance of not allowing unruly children to distract drivers, suggesting that drivers pull over if necessary. Its tone is serious and cautionary, aimed at Irish drivers.

This PSA from the [nomore.org](http://nomore.org) campaign shows a montage of a cluttered home, including neglected dishes and a dented wall, set against a 911 call. The call, based on a real incident, features a woman ordering pizza, a euphemism for calling the authorities because she cannot speak freely with her abuser nearby, which the dispatcher eventually recognizes. The tone is serious, aimed at victims of domestic violence and sexual abuse.

This is a 90s advertisement for a portable cellular phone available at Radio Shack. It shows a bespectacled man using the large portable phone in various settings, such as on a boat, at lunch, or in a park, highlighting its portability and ease of use. The ad provides information and appeals to a wide audience.

This is an ad for Little Baby's Ice Cream, featuring a figure made of vanilla ice cream, staring intently at the camera while scooping ice cream from its head with a spoon and eating it. The video appears to be flipped horizontally, as indicated by the flipped on-screen text. The tone is surreal and creepy, aimed at a wide audience.

This is an infomercial for the Slush Mug, available at [Vat19.com](http://Vat19.com), a store specializing in novelty gifts. It showcases the Slush Mug as an easy, quick way to make consistent slushies from regular drinks (except, humorously, with diet beverages), thanks to its patent-pending GlacialCore. The tone is informative yet humorous, appealing to fans of novelty items.

This UK women's aid organization has produced an anti-domestic abuse PSA. It shows actress Keira Knightley returning home from a shoot to find a shattered mirror, splattered with blood. Blood drops lead to her husband's bloody knuckles, as he verbalizes and physically assaults Knightley over an alleged unscripted kiss with a male co-star. The tone is serious and visceral, specifically addressing female victims of domestic violence.

This is a PSA by Global NCAP showing test cars made in India with crash test dummies. They all crash into a wall at high speed, testing the vehicle's safety when no airbags deploy, resulting in very low scores. The tone is informative and aimed at a wide audience.

This anti-smoking PSA features a man speaking directly to the camera as a group of smokers socializes nearby. Each time they exhale smoke, a fatty residue falls from the cigarette, which the man explains clogs arteries. This is illustrated using a removed artery from a 32-year-old smoker. The tone remains serious and informative, specifically targeting smokers.

This is an advertisement for Breville's The Oracle espresso machine. It highlights The Oracle's features, capabilities, and user-friendly design, allowing even beginners to brew a perfect espresso. The content is informative, innovative, and appeals to coffee enthusiasts.

This is an advertisement for American Express featuring director Wes Anderson. He is shown amid the shoot, talking directly to the viewer about his creative process while overseeing every detail from setup to filming. The tone is humorous, appealing to Wes Anderson enthusiasts and prospective American Express card applicants.

This is an ad for A&W root beer set in a job interview scene. It shows a potential employee repeatedly and awkwardly calling his boss "Mr. Dumbass," while the boss's actual name is "Mr. Dumass." The commercial concludes with the boss calling the candidate a true "dumbass." The tone is humorous and aimed at mature root beer fans.

This ad for Represent, a celebrity merchandise store, showcases Arnold Schwarzenegger from his early bodybuilding days to the present. It features him training with a dwarf while promoting his merchandise line. The tone is lighthearted and humorous, aimed at Arnold fans.

This is an advertisement for the Samsung ST550 and TL225 digital cameras. Styled as a tutorial on how to improve self-photography, it features monsters and mythological characters from fiction and demonstrates the tips shown in onscreen text, leading to more flattering photos. The tone is humorous and informative, appealing to a wide audience.

This is an advertisement for Club Mahindra cruise line. It shows Priyanka Chopra Jonas speaking directly to the camera, inviting viewers to book their stay at Club Mahindra. Meanwhile, B-Roll footage highlights the cruise's amenities. The tone is informative and specifically aimed at an Indian audience.

This is an advertisement for Gucci's Men's Tailoring. It features a young man in a fitted two-piece suit going about his day while several men—a taxi driver, a shoeshiner, and a barber—share the story of a young man who pays his tailor with stock bonds that initially hold no value. As the young man achieves greater success, those bonds become extremely valuable. The ad concludes with the young man informing his barber, "My tailor wasn't English. He was Italian." The tone is cinematic and aimed at fashion-conscious men.

This ad promotes AA, an Irish car insurance provider. It features a male narrator speaking over uplifting music, highlighting that cars cannot understand the human experience. However, AA claims to consider the human element by offering fully comprehensive coverage on insured vehicles, including rentals, to its members. The tone is informative and aimed at Irish drivers.

This ad promotes LYNXjet, a PR campaign for Lynx deodorant. It depicts scenes from the fictional LYNXjet airline, showcasing its amenities, including alluring female flight attendants in provocative uniforms, hot tubs, and in-flight entertainment featuring them. The tone is playful and tongue-in-cheek, primarily targeting a male audience.

This is an Indian advertisement for Cadbury 5 Star chocolate bars. It shows two simple-minded young men buying two bars at a small kiosk when a van carrying bank robbers arrives and enters the bank. Casually, the two men then hop onto the van and drive away as the robbers load the money bags into the trunk, leaving them behind. The tone is humorous and appeals to a wide Indian audience.

This Old El Paso advertisement presents a step-by-step recipe for making taco hummus. It highlights the ingredients and detailed preparation steps, while encouraging viewers to visit the Old El Paso website for the full recipe. The tone is informative and aimed at home cooks.

This Burger King ad, created in partnership with The Simpsons Movie's marketing team, is set in the real world. It features real people being transformed into Simpsons characters by the aliens from the show (the Simpsons' aliens) using their beams. The tone is humorous and appeals to a wide audience.

This ad for The Red House Furniture & Appliance features store workers and customers speaking to the camera. They discuss their inventory, emphasizing low prices and highlighting that they serve both Black and white customers, with a particular focus on the latter quality throughout the ad. The tone is informative, lighthearted, and subtly racial, aimed at North Carolina residents.

This ad promotes Korean food by showcasing staple dishes like citron tea, makgeolli, and kimchi through a montage of Korean models posing with them. The visuals are overlaid on moving graphics that resemble a magazine cover. The tone is informative and encourages viewers to try Korean dishes.

This is a commercial for Ferrero Kinder Surprise Eggs. It shows a lifelike Humpty Dumpty speaking in a pretend foreign language as he opens a Kinder Egg while sitting on his namesake wall, revealing its inside. The tone is surreal and humorous, appealing to a broad audience.

This brief PSA short film addresses bullying. It takes place on a school playground, showing a young boy being bullied as a group of children watches, some encouraging the fight to start. While some kids stand by idly, others intervene to peacefully de-escalate the conflict and support the victim. The tone is serious and motivational, aimed at school-aged children.

This is an Indian advertisement for Cadbury's Dairy Milk chocolate bars. It shows a montage of everyday Indians of all ages going about their day, always happy while enjoying Cadbury chocolate. A cheerful guitar song plays in the background. The tone is lively and emotional, aimed at a wide Indian audience.

This advertisement promotes the LG G5 modular phone, highlighting its customizable features like transforming into a digital camera and a music speaker with various accessories. It emphasizes the device's versatility and the freedom it offers to consumers. The tone is informative and appeals to a broad, tech-savvy audience.

This is a GameFly ad made in partnership with the Disney movie Wreck-It-Ralph. It features a male narrator and Wreck-It-Ralph characters commenting on GameFly's game rental service, explaining how to rent games and highlighting the convenience it offers. The tone is humorous and informative, aimed at gamers.

This is an advertisement for Visa. It shows a baseball team manager questioning their starting shortstop, Derek Jeter, about his spending spree at different dance clubs and restaurants. Jetter responds by showing his Visa card. The tone is humorous and aimed at card-carrying adults.

This is an 80s advertisement for Mentos mints. It shows a young man whose path is blocked by traffic, preventing him from crossing the street. After he takes a Mentos, he cleverly navigates through traffic by getting into the back of one car and emerging from another, with his friends watching and cheering. The mood is playful and appeals to a broad audience.

This ad for NAC Jewellers depicts Indian aunties hurriedly assisting a young bride as she prepares. The bride is shown trying on various jewelry pieces, such as earrings, intricate necklaces, and headpieces, only to be disappointed and attempt different options. The tone is humorous and aimed at an Indian audience.

This Ikea ad shows identical girl twins standing in front of two side-by-side ovens, jealous of their ability to do two tasks at once, which their mom clearly loves. The humor is light and appeals to a broad adult audience.

This video from BuzzFeed highlights the contrast between tampon commercials and real life. It shows how actresses in ads appear glamorous, cinematic, and free of struggles, compared to a more realistic portrayal of a modern woman. The tone is humorous and aimed at a broad Internet audience.

This is an advertisement for Burger King Germany (as shown by the domain name burgerking.de). It shows two cholos in a low rider pulling up beside two women at a stoplight. The women are too busy eating their Whoppers to notice the cholos' showboating. After excessive bouncing, the low rider breaks down, and the women laugh at their misfortune. The tone is humorous and aimed at a German audience.
